strategies.bestOn: Single-asset trend measurements across multiple horizons
strategies.description: Recent periods get more weight in the composite. A positive composite can produce a partial position even when one of the shorter horizons is negative.

zh.bestOn: 按多个周期衡量单一资产趋势
zh.description: 综合评分更侧重近期周期。即使其中一个短周期收益率为负，综合分数仍可能支持部分仓位。
notes: 站点对各品种单独回测，并在下一个可用收益区间应用日度目标。
Pine 示例在每次确认收盘时尝试再平衡。品种最小交易单位和模拟成交可能影响实际仓位比例。

Entry: 预热后，综合分数大于强信号门槛且有三个正收益周期时，目标为 75%。在同一分支中，四个周期均为正且最短周期为正时，目标为 100%。否则，当综合分数为正且至少两个周期为正时，目标为 50%。
Exit: 两个入场条件均未满足时，若综合分数为负或正收益周期至多一个，则目标归零。其余情况沿用上次目标。
Indicators: 各周期收益率除以其最近 63 条观测的样本标准差加一个很小的常量，再按权重求和，并计算收益率为正的周期个数。
Inputs: 默认周期为 21、63、126 和 252 个交易日，对应权重为 0.4、0.3、0.2 和 0.1，强信号门槛为 0。
Position sizing: 目标为现金或 50%、75%、100% 的多头仓位。

zh.summary: 用四个标准化动量周期决定分档多头仓位。

strategies.name: Accelerating Momentum
notes: The site evaluates each instrument separately and applies the daily target to the next available return interval.
The Pine example attempts to rebalance each confirmed close. Symbol lot sizes and simulated fills can affect the realized weight.

Entry: After warming up, a score above the strong-entry threshold and three positive periods sets 75%. Four positive periods and a positive shortest return set 100% in that same branch. Otherwise a positive score with at least two positive periods sets 50%.
Exit: If neither entry branch applies, a negative composite or at most one positive period sets zero. Otherwise retain the previous target.
Indicators: Divide each period return by its own trailing 63-row sample standard deviation plus a small constant. Weight these ratios and count the periods with positive returns.
Inputs: Default periods 21, 63, 126 and 252 sessions. Corresponding weights 0.4, 0.3, 0.2 and 0.1. Strong-entry threshold 0.
Position sizing: Targets are cash or 50%, 75% or 100% long.

strategies.summary: Uses four standardized momentum horizons to set graduated long exposure.

strategies.description: The smoothing rate adapts to the ratio of absolute net price change to the total absolute change. Price relative to KAMA and the average's five-bar slope drive the target.

zh.description: 平滑速度随净价格变动绝对值与逐日变动绝对值之和的比率调整。仓位由收盘价与 KAMA 的相对位置和均线五根斜率决定。
notes: 第一个 er_period 根窗口末尾的收盘价作为 KAMA 初始值。

Entry: 经过 er_period + slope_period 根预热后，收盘高于 KAMA 且 KAMA 高于 slope_period 根前水平时做多。
Exit: 收盘不高于 KAMA 时转现金。如果收盘在 KAMA 上方而斜率不为正，维持原仓位。
Indicators: 效率比 ER 为 er_period 内净变动的绝对值除以各次变动绝对值之和。分母为零时令 ER = 0。
令 f = 2/(fast + 1)、s = 2/(slow + 1)。以 [ER ×（f − s）+ s]² 乘以现价与上一 KAMA 之差来更新 KAMA。

zh.summary: 用上行的考夫曼自适应均线确认多头入场。

strategies.name: Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average
notes: Seed KAMA with the close at the end of the first er_period-bar window.

Entry: After er_period + slope_period bars, set long when the close exceeds KAMA and KAMA is higher than slope_period bars before.
Exit: Set cash when price is at or below KAMA. Otherwise, if price is above but the slope is nonpositive, carry the prior target.
Indicators: ER is absolute price change over er_period divided by the sum of absolute changes. A zero denominator gives ER = 0.
Let f = 2/(fast + 1), s = 2/(slow + 1). Add [ER × (f − s) + s]² times (current close − previous KAMA) to the previous KAMA.

strategies.summary: Uses a rising Kaufman adaptive average to confirm long entries.

strategies.description: This OHLC-based filter takes a long position when ADX exceeds 25 and +DI leads −DI. It recomputes the target at every close.

zh.description: 策略用 OHLC 计算 ADX 和方向指标。ADX 高于 25 且 +DI 大于 −DI 时做多，每个交易日收盘重新计算仓位。
notes: 默认参数要求 ADX 高于 25 才持仓，20 的退出阈值在这组设置下不产生额外的退出信号。

Entry: ADX 高于 adx_threshold 且 +DI 大于 −DI 时做多。开启 allow_short 后，若 ADX 达标且 −DI 大于 +DI 则做空。
Exit: 方向指标或入场强度条件失效，或 ADX 低于 exit_threshold 时空仓。
Indicators: 以参数 α = 1/period 的指数加权均值平滑真实波幅和方向变动，再用同样的平滑方式从 DX 得到 ADX。
Position sizing: 默认满仓做多或持有现金。开启空头后，做空目标为 −100%。

zh.summary: 每天用 ADX 和方向指标决定仓位。

strategies.name: ADX Trend Filter
notes: The default exit_threshold of 20 adds no independent exit condition because a position already requires ADX above 25.

Entry: Set a long target when ADX is above adx_threshold and +DI exceeds −DI. With allow_short enabled, set a short target if ADX passes and −DI exceeds +DI.
Exit: Go flat if the relevant direction or entry-strength condition fails, or if ADX is below exit_threshold.
Indicators: Smooth true range and directional movement with an exponentially weighted mean (alpha = 1/period). Apply the same smoothing to DX to obtain ADX.
Position sizing: 100% long or cash by default. With shorts enabled, the short target is −100%.

strategies.summary: Uses ADX and directional indicators to set exposure each day.

strategies.description: The rule tracks Aroon Up and Down over a window of closing prices. Separate entry and exit thresholds let an established long position persist until the indicators weaken.

zh.description: 用收盘价窗口计算 Aroon Up 和 Aroon Down。入场与退出阈值分开，建仓后可维持至指标转弱。
notes: 默认用 26 个收盘价计算。

Entry: 空仓时，Aroon Up 高于 70 且 Aroon Down 低于 30 则做多。
Exit: 持仓时，Aroon Up 低于 50 或 Aroon Down 高于 50 则平仓，其他情况持有。
Indicators: 使用当前收盘价及此前 period 个收盘价。指标为 100 ×（period − 距极值的 K 线根数）÷ period。
出现相同极值时，选窗口内最早出现的位置。

zh.summary: 用距离收盘价极值的时间判断趋势。

strategies.name: Aroon Indicator
notes: At the defaults the calculation uses 26 closes.

Entry: From cash, set long when Aroon Up is above 70 and Aroon Down is below 30.
Exit: While long, go flat if Aroon Up is below 50 or Aroon Down is above 50. Otherwise hold.
Indicators: Use the current close plus period prior closes. For each extreme, compute 100 × (period − bars since extreme)/period.
Use the oldest occurrence when equal closes tie for an extreme.

strategies.summary: Measures trend from the recency of closing-price extremes.

strategies.description: A single trailing-return window ranks the four asset classes. The default absolute momentum filter keeps only winners above zero.

zh.bestOn: 跨资产战术动量轮动
zh.description: 用同一回看窗口的区间收益率给四类资产排名。默认绝对动量过滤只保留收益率大于零的入选资产。
notes: 组合使用 SPY、GLD、USO 与 EURUSD=X 均有完整行情的共同交易日。
在新月份首次观察到共同交易日时，使用上一条已完成行情确定目标仓位。目标在下一个可用收益区间生效。

Entry: 选择可用评分最高的两项资产，再保留其中收益率大于零的资产。
Exit: 在月度决策时清空落选资产。没有资产通过过滤时持有现金。
Indicators: 用同一 126 个交易日窗口计算各资产的区间收盘价收益率。
Inputs: 默认回看窗口为 126 个交易日，取前 2 名，并启用正收益率过滤。
Position sizing: 将全部目标权重在通过过滤的资产之间等分。

zh.summary: 每月轮动到区间收益率为正且排名前两位的资产。

strategies.name: Asset Class Rotation
notes: The basket uses the common completed sessions of SPY, GLD, USO and EURUSD=X.
Set targets on the first common session observed in a new month using the preceding completed session. The target takes effect on the next available return interval.

Entry: Select the two highest available scores and keep those with returns above zero.
Exit: Clear dropped assets at the monthly decision. Go to cash if no asset passes the filter.
Indicators: Compute each asset's trailing closing-price return on the same 126-session window.
Inputs: Default lookback 126 sessions, top 2 assets and positive-return filter enabled.
Position sizing: Divide the full target equally among the assets that pass.

strategies.summary: Rotates monthly into the top two assets with positive trailing returns.
strategies.targetTiming: First observed session of a new month, using the prior observation; engine applies one-row lag.

strategies.bestOn: Markets with volatility contractions and expansions
strategies.description: Bollinger-Keltner Squeeze is the historical name. This implementation detects a squeeze from Bollinger bandwidth relative to its own history and waits for positive price momentum before going long.

zh.bestOn: 波动收缩与扩张交替的市场
zh.description: 布林-肯特纳挤压是历史名称。实际规则将布林带宽度与自身历史比较，识别压缩后等待价格动量转正再做多。
notes: 压缩与入场可相隔数个交易日，入场当天需要已经离开压缩状态且动量为正。

Entry: 曾出现压缩，当前已离开压缩状态且动量为正时做多。
Exit: 动量为负、相对入场收盘价跌幅超过 5%，或持仓计数超过 20 根 K 线时平仓。
Indicators: 布林带上下轨为 20 根 K 线的收盘价简单均线加减 2 倍样本标准差。用上下轨之差除以中轨加一个很小的常量，得到带宽。
带宽不高于最近 50 根 K 线的第 25 百分位时判为压缩。动量等于收盘价减去 12 根简单均线。

zh.summary: 布林带宽度压缩结束且收盘价动量为正时做多。

strategies.name: Bollinger-Keltner Squeeze
notes: A detected squeeze can arm an entry several sessions later, as long as the current bar is out of the squeeze and momentum is positive.

Entry: Go long when a squeeze has been recorded, the current bar is out of the squeeze and momentum is positive.
Exit: Exit when momentum is negative, the close is more than 5% below the entry close or the holding count exceeds 20 bars.
Indicators: The Bollinger bands are the 20-bar closing-price SMA plus or minus 2 sample standard deviations. Divide their difference by the middle band plus a small offset to get bandwidth.
A squeeze occurs at or below the current 50-bar 25th percentile of bandwidth. Momentum is close minus its 12-bar simple average.
Inputs: Default: bb_period = 20, bb_std = 2, momentum_period = 12, squeeze_lookback = 50, squeeze_percentile = 25, max_hold = 20.

strategies.summary: Buys after a Bollinger bandwidth squeeze when closing-price momentum is positive.

strategies.description: Uses closing-price Bollinger bands and a bandwidth filter. The stop follows the current lower band; it is not a fixed loss from the entry price.

zh.description: 用收盘价布林带与带宽过滤。止损参考当前下轨，不是相对入场价格的固定亏损比例。
notes: 带宽高于均值不代表当天仍在上升；两倍标准差带并不保证覆盖95%的价格。

Entry: 收盘价≤下轨，且带宽>自身均值。
Exit: 收盘价≥中轨、持仓间隔≥10个观测，或收盘价<当前下轨的97%时退出。
Indicators: SMA20加减2倍样本标准差；带宽=(上轨−下轨)/中轨，与其20行简单均值比较。
Inputs: period=20，num_std=2，max_hold=10；默认从第40号观测行开始判断（首行为0）。

zh.summary: 价格触及下轨且带宽高于近期均值时做多。

strategies.name: Bollinger Band Reversion
notes: Above-average bandwidth need not be rising. Two-standard-deviation bands do not guarantee95% price coverage.

Entry: Close≤lower band AND bandwidth>its moving average.
Exit: Close≥middle, holding age≥10 observations, or close<0.97×current lower band.
Indicators: SMA20 ±2 sample standard deviations; bandwidth=(upper−lower)/middle, compared with its 20-row SMA.
Inputs: period=20, num_std=2, max_hold=10; decisions start at row40 with defaults.

strategies.summary: Buy a lower-band touch when bandwidth is above its recent average.

strategies.description: CCI uses closing price instead of classic OHLC typical price. Entry is a level test and does not require a new threshold crossing.

zh.description: CCI使用收盘价，替代经典OHLC典型价格；入场判断当前水平，不要求刚刚穿越阈值。
notes: 极端止损仅在已有持仓时检查；低于−200的读数仍可能触发新入场。.015缩放不保证固定覆盖比例。

Entry: 空仓时，CCI<−100则做多。
Exit: 持仓时，CCI≥0、持仓间隔≥15个观测或CCI<−200则退出。
Indicators: CCI=(收盘价−SMA20)/(.015×20行窗口内相对该均值的平均绝对偏差)。

zh.summary: 收盘价近似CCI低于−100时做多，回升或触及限制时退出。

strategies.name: CCI Mean Reversion
notes: The extreme stop is checked only while holding; the entry rule can accept a reading already below−200. The.015 scale gives no guaranteed coverage percentage.

Entry: When flat, enter if CCI<−100.
Exit: While held, exit if CCI≥0, holding age≥15 observations, or CCI<−200.
Indicators: CCI=(close−SMA20)/(.015×20-row mean absolute deviation from that window mean).

strategies.summary: Buy a close-only CCI below−100 and exit on recovery or limits.

strategies.description: The thresholds start from a rolling highest and lowest close. Their distances use an ATR approximation based on absolute changes between successive closes.

zh.description: 通过滚动最高和最低收盘价设置门槛，并用相邻收盘价变动绝对值的均值近似 ATR，调整两个门槛的距离。
notes: 预热 atr_period + 1 根 K 线后，先按上涨状态检查退出门槛。

Entry: 退出后保持空仓，直到收盘价严格高于重新入场线时做多。
Exit: 上涨状态中，收盘价严格低于退出线时转为现金，否则目标为多头。
Indicators: 波幅取最近 22 根 K 线的收盘价变动绝对值的简单均值。
退出线为 22 根最高收盘价减去 3 倍波幅。重新入场线为 22 根最低收盘价加 3 倍波幅。两个窗口均含当前收盘价。

zh.summary: 用收盘价计算吊灯止损与重新入场的门槛。

strategies.name: Chandelier Exit
notes: After a warm-up of atr_period + 1 bars, the rule starts by checking the exit threshold from an uptrend state.

Entry: When flat after an exit, re-enter if the close is strictly above the re-entry threshold.
Exit: In the uptrend state, go to cash when the close is strictly below the exit threshold. Otherwise target long.
Indicators: Range proxy: the 22-bar simple average of absolute close-to-close changes.
Exit threshold: 22-bar highest close minus 3 times the range proxy. Re-entry threshold: 22-bar lowest close plus 3 times the range proxy. The windows include the current close.

strategies.summary: Uses closing-price Chandelier thresholds for long exits and re-entries.

strategies.description: Cointegration Basket is the strategy name. The rule fits a rolling OLS regression of SPY against the rest of the configured basket and trades standardized one-step residuals.

zh.bestOn: 研究多资产回归价差
zh.description: 协整组合是该策略名称。规则用配置组合的其余资产对 SPY 做滚动 OLS 回归，交易标准化后的一步样本外残差。
notes: 站点回测以 SPY、GLD、USO、EURUSD=X、DBC、SLV、DBA、UNG、BTC-USD 与 ETH-USD 的共同完整行情为输入。界面以 SPY 标识这组组合。
站点规则使用带截距的 OLS 回归，未做正式平稳性检验。
信号回归每日更新，持仓中的对冲权重沿用入场时的系数。日度目标在下一个共同收益区间生效。

Entry: 预热 130 条观测且残差窗口有效后，z 低于 −2 时做多残差，z 高于 +2 时做空残差。
Exit: 在评分有效的观测上，z 高于 −0.5 时平多仓，z 低于 +0.5 时平空仓。达到 20 条观测的持仓上限也会在评分有效时平仓。
Indicators: 每个可计算日使用之前 60 条已完成的对数价格观测拟合 OLS，再用模型计算当前残差，并在真实一步残差的滚动样本中进行标准化。
Inputs: 默认回归窗口为 60 个交易日，z 分数样本为先前 60 个残差加当前残差，入场门槛为 2，退出门槛为 0.5，持仓上限为 20 条观测。
Position sizing: 做多残差时，目标资产权重为 +1，其他资产为各自回归系数的相反数。做空时将符号反转，再归一化至 100% 总敞口。

zh.summary: 交易多个资产滚动对数价格回归中的极端残差。

strategies.name: Cointegration Basket
notes: The site backtest aligns SPY, GLD, USO, EURUSD=X, DBC, SLV, DBA, UNG, BTC-USD and ETH-USD on their common completed sessions. Its SPY display label identifies the basket.
The published rule fits OLS with an intercept and has no formal stationarity test.
Signal fits update daily. The hedge weights of an open trade remain at their entry values, and daily targets take effect on the next common return interval.

Entry: After the 130-row warmup and with a valid residual window, z below −2 opens a long residual and z above +2 opens a short residual.
Exit: On valid score rows, exit the long when z is above −0.5, or exit the short when z is below +0.5. The 20-observation holding limit also closes a trade on a valid score row.
Indicators: On each eligible day fit OLS to the preceding 60 completed log-price rows. Evaluate the fit on the current row and standardize its residual against the rolling sample of real one-step residuals.
Inputs: Default regression lookback 60 sessions, z-score lookback 60 earlier residuals plus the current residual, entry z-score 2, exit z-score 0.5 and holding limit 20 observations.
Position sizing: For a long residual, take +1 in the target and the negative of each fitted coefficient in the other assets. Reverse the signs for a short residual and scale to 100% gross.

strategies.summary: Trades extreme residuals from rolling multi-asset log-price regressions.

strategies.description: This Connors-style variant averages price RSI, signed-streak RSI and return rank. Corrected RSI maps positive gains without losses to100, losses without gains to0, and flat or unavailable windows to50.

zh.description: 此Connors式变体将价格RSI、带符号连涨跌RSI与收益排名取平均。修正后的RSI在有上涨无下跌时为100、有下跌无上涨时为0、横盘或未充分预热时为50。
notes: 这不是Wilder平滑RSI；边界修正可能改变回升退出时点，证据须标明规则版本。

Entry: 100个观测后，CRSI<10则入场。
Exit: CRSI>50或持仓间隔≥10个观测时退出。
Indicators: 两项RSI使用涨跌额的滚动简单均值；当前单期收益在包含自身的100期收益中排名，并列取平均秩；CRSI为三项平均。

zh.summary: 组合简单均值价格/连涨跌RSI与包含当前收益的排名。

strategies.name: Connors RSI
notes: This is not Wilder-smoothed RSI. Boundary correction can change recovery exits; evidence must identify the rule version.

Entry: After 100 observations, enter when CRSI<10.
Exit: Exit when CRSI>50 or holding age≥10 observations.
Indicators: Both RSIs use simple rolling mean gains/losses. Rank is the current one-row return within 100 returns including itself, with average ranks for ties. CRSI averages the three components.
Inputs: price_rsi_period=3, streak_rsi_period=2, rank_period=100, entry_threshold=10, exit_threshold=50, max_hold=10.

strategies.summary: Combine SMA-based price/streak RSI with an inclusive return rank.

strategies.description: The daily implementation smooths the sum of two closing-price rates of change with a linearly weighted moving average.

zh.description: 用收盘价计算两个变化率，再对两者之和取线性加权移动平均。
notes: 原版指标用于月线，本站窗口单位为日线根数。

Entry: 曲线严格为正时做多。
Exit: 曲线为零、为负或尚未算出时持有现金。
Indicators: ROC(n) 等于当前收盘除以 n 根 K 线前的收盘，再减 1。使用从 1 到 wma_window 的线性权重平滑两条 ROC 的和。

zh.summary: 日线估波曲线为正时做多。

strategies.name: Coppock Curve
notes: The original indicator was designed for monthly data. These lookbacks are in daily bars.

Entry: Set long whenever the curve is strictly positive.
Exit: Use cash when the curve is zero, negative, or unavailable.
Indicators: ROC(n) is close divided by the close n bars earlier minus 1. Smooth the sum with linear weights 1 through wma_window.

strategies.summary: Holds long when the daily Coppock curve is positive.

strategies.description: The rule measures annualized volatility from daily returns of the instrument being tested. It targets a short position above the threshold and holds cash otherwise.

zh.description: 策略用当前回测标的的日收益率计算年化波动率，超过门槛时做空，其余时间持有现金。
notes: 波动率信号来自所测标的。高波动反弹时，空头仓位可能亏损。

Entry: 年化波动率高于 30% 时设为空头。
Exit: 波动率不超过阈值或暂时无法计算时转为现金。
Indicators: 滚动窗口内日收益率的样本标准差乘 √252 得到已实现波动率。

zh.summary: 所测标的的已实现波动率超过门槛时做空。

strategies.name: Crisis Alpha
notes: The volatility signal comes from the tested instrument. Short exposure can lose money in a volatile rally.

Entry: Set the target to short when annualized volatility is above 30%.
Exit: Go to cash when volatility is at or below the threshold or unavailable.
Indicators: Realized volatility: rolling sample standard deviation of daily returns multiplied by √252.

strategies.summary: Shorts the tested market when its realized volatility exceeds a threshold.

strategies.bestOn: Cross-asset allocation with directional risk tilts
strategies.description: A daily score combines the recent mean returns of SPY and GLD with opposite signs. Its sign changes the relative weights of SPY, USO and GLD.

zh.bestOn: 根据风险倾向调整跨资产配置
zh.description: 每日评分综合 SPY 和 GLD 的近期平均收益率，两者方向相反。按分数正负调整 SPY、USO 和 GLD 的相对权重。
notes: 站点回测以 SPY、GLD、USO、EURUSD=X、DBC、SLV、DBA、UNG、BTC-USD 与 ETH-USD 的共同完整行情为输入。界面以 SPY 标识这组组合。
风险倾向由分数正负决定。站点在下一个共同收益区间应用日度目标。

Entry: 分数为正时，SPY 和 USO 的逆波动率权重乘以 1.5，否则乘以 0.3。分数为负时，GLD 的逆波动率权重乘以 1.5，否则乘以 0.5。
Exit: 前 36 条观测为预热期，随后每日更新目标。
Indicators: 从滞后数据计算 100 × SPY 平均收益率 − 50 × GLD 平均收益率。使用当日的 20 个日收益率计算年化样本波动率，波动率缺失或低于 1% 时用 15%。
Inputs: 默认动量窗口为 21 个日收益率，信号滞后 5 个交易日，波动率窗口为 20 个日收益率。
Position sizing: 其他资产的逆波动率权重乘以 0.5。将全组合权重归一化为 100% 多头。

zh.summary: 根据滞后的 SPY 和 GLD 动量调整组合权重。

strategies.name: Cross-Asset Momentum
notes: The site backtest aligns SPY, GLD, USO, EURUSD=X, DBC, SLV, DBA, UNG, BTC-USD and ETH-USD on their common completed sessions. Its SPY display label identifies the basket.
The sign of the score determines the tilt. The site applies the daily target to the next common return interval.

Entry: Multiply inverse volatility for SPY and USO by 1.5 for a positive score and 0.3 otherwise. Multiply GLD by 1.5 for a negative score and 0.5 otherwise.
Exit: Recompute targets daily after 36 observed rows of warmup.
Indicators: Compute 100 × mean SPY return minus 50 × mean GLD return from the lagged history. Use current 20-return annualized sample volatility and substitute 15% if the estimate is unavailable or below 1%.
Inputs: Default momentum lookback 21 daily returns, signal lag 5 sessions, volatility lookback 20 returns.
Position sizing: All other assets use 0.5 times inverse volatility. Normalize the whole basket to 100% long.

strategies.summary: Tilts basket weights according to lagged SPY and GLD momentum.

strategies.description: Each month, rank the four assets by trailing closing-price return. Allocate more to the lower-volatility asset among the selected names.

zh.bestOn: 跨资产动量轮动
zh.description: 每月用收盘价区间收益率对四项资产排名。入选资产中，波动率越低，目标权重越高。
notes: 组合使用 SPY、GLD、USO 与 EURUSD=X 均有完整行情的共同交易日。
在新月份首次观察到共同交易日时，使用上一条已完成行情确定目标仓位。目标在下一个可用收益区间生效。

Entry: 选择收益率最高且有可用数据的两项资产，收益率为负也可入选。
Exit: 月度调仓时将未入选资产的目标归零。入选资产均无可用正波动率时持有现金。
Indicators: 分别计算各资产的 252 个交易日收盘价收益率，以及最近 60 个日收益率的样本标准差。
Inputs: 默认收益率窗口为 252 个交易日，波动率窗口为 60 个日收益率，取前 2 名。
Position sizing: 按各入选资产波动率的倒数归一化。波动率缺失或为零的资产权重为零。

zh.summary: 选择区间收益率最高的两项资产，再按逆波动率分配权重。

strategies.name: Cross-Sectional Momentum
notes: The basket uses the common completed sessions of SPY, GLD, USO and EURUSD=X.
Set targets on the first common session observed in a new month using the preceding completed session. The target takes effect on the next available return interval.

Entry: Pick the highest two available returns, regardless of sign.
Exit: Clear dropped assets at rebalance. Go to cash if no selected asset has usable positive volatility.
Indicators: Calculate each asset's 252-session closing-price return and sample standard deviation of 60 daily returns.
Inputs: Default return lookback 252 sessions, volatility lookback 60 returns, top 2 assets.
Position sizing: Assign the selected assets weights proportional to 1 / volatility. Unavailable or zero estimates receive zero weight.

strategies.summary: Selects the two strongest trailing returns and weights them by inverse volatility.
strategies.targetTiming: First observed session of a new month, using the prior observation; engine applies one-row lag.

strategies.description: This Darvas-style rule uses a rolling OHLC price box. Its upper and lower limits are the highest high and lowest low from the prior complete window.

zh.description: 这套达瓦斯箱体规则用 OHLC 数据构建滚动箱体，上下沿为此前完整窗口内的最高价和最低价。
notes: 持仓期间箱体仍每天更新。生产回测使用 OHLC 数据。

Entry: 收盘严格高于此前箱体上沿时做多。
Exit: 收盘严格低于此前箱体下沿时空仓，其他情况维持原目标。
Indicators: 用此前 box_period 根 K 线的 High 和 Low 构建箱体，窗口不含当前 K 线。

zh.summary: 收盘向上突破此前滚动最高价时做多，跌破此前滚动最低价时平仓。

strategies.name: Darvas Box
notes: The box updates each day while holding. Production tests use OHLC bars.

Entry: Go long if the close strictly exceeds the previous box high.
Exit: Go flat if the close is strictly below the previous box low, otherwise keep the prior target.
Indicators: Build the box from the previous box_period highs and lows. The current bar is outside the calculation window.

strategies.summary: Buys a close above the previous rolling high and exits below the previous rolling low.

strategies.description: Detrended Price Oscillator (DPO) removes longer-term trend by comparing a shifted price to its moving average. This strategy buys when DPO is deeply negative and exits near the zero line.
strategies.name: Detrended Price Oscillator
notes: DPO is a cycle indicator, not a trend indicator

Entry: Go long when DPO% < Entry_Level
Exit: Exit when DPO% > Exit_Level
Indicators: SMA(Period)
DPO = Close.shift(Period/2 + 1) - SMA

strategies.summary: Mean reversion using a detrended price oscillator.

strategies.description: A higher price low with a lower nearby RSI/MACD low enters long; a lower price high with a higher nearby indicator high exits. Pivots require order observations on each side; targets change only at confirmation and persist between events.
strategies.name: Divergence Strategy
notes: Version 2 preserves the implemented hidden-divergence direction, rather than the old regular-divergence description.
At confirmation, the latest pivot must be within lookback observations and the preceding pivot within 2 * lookback; lookback must exceed order for events.
RSI uses simple rolling means; MACD uses indicator_period for its fast EMA and 26 for its slow EMA.
Version 1 revised historical signals and did not hold between events; its results are not comparable to version 2.
strategies.summary: Hold long between confirmed bullish and bearish hidden divergences.
strategies.targetTiming: Target changes at pivot confirmation close after order right-hand observations; engine applies one-row lag.

strategies.description: A close-based Donchian rule with fixed windows. A breakout above the long window establishes full long exposure. A break below the short window moves to cash.

zh.description: 以收盘价构建固定窗口的唐奇安通道。向上突破长期通道后满仓做多，向下跌破短期通道后转为现金。
notes: 两个通道都不含当前收盘价。收盘价在门槛之间或等于门槛时，维持原仓位。

Entry: 收盘价严格高于上轨时做多。
Exit: 收盘价严格低于下轨时转为现金。
Indicators: 此前 55 日最高收盘价及此前 20 日最低收盘价。
Inputs: 固定值：突破窗口 55 日，退出窗口 20 日。

zh.summary: 突破此前 55 日最高收盘价时做多，跌破此前 20 日最低收盘价时平仓。

strategies.name: Donchian Breakout
notes: Both channels exclude the current close. Between the two trigger levels or at equality, the previous target carries forward.

Entry: Go long when the close strictly exceeds the upper channel.
Exit: Go to cash when the close is strictly below the lower channel.
Indicators: Highest close of the previous 55 sessions and lowest close of the previous 20 sessions.

strategies.summary: Buys above the prior 55-session closing high and exits below the prior 20-session closing low.

strategies.bestOn: Single instruments with recurring price drawdowns
strategies.description: The rule measures the tested instrument's drawdown from its rolling peak. The daily long target decreases linearly above the drawdown threshold, subject to a minimum allocation.

zh.bestOn: 经常出现价格回撤的单标的市场
zh.description: 以所测标的相对滚动峰值的跌幅计算仓位。超过回撤阈值后，目标仓位线性降低至最低配置比例。
notes: 阈值控制仓位比例，实际亏损可超过该阈值。
Pine 下载版在每次确认收盘时尝试再平衡。品种最小交易单位和模拟成交可能影响实际仓位比例。

Entry: d 不超过 max_drawdown 时设为满仓。首根也设为满仓。
Exit: d 超过 max_drawdown 时，用 max(min_position, 1 − (d − max_drawdown) × scale ÷ max_drawdown)。收盘价或滚动高点变化时重新计算。
Indicators: 回撤幅度 d 为当前收盘相对滚动最高收盘价的跌幅。历史不足一个窗口时用已有收盘价。
Position sizing: 默认设置目标多头为 10% 到 100%。

zh.summary: 所测标的较滚动收盘高点回落时逐步降低多头仓位。

strategies.name: Drawdown Control
notes: The threshold governs allocation and is not a realized loss limit.
The Pine download attempts to rebalance each confirmed close. Symbol lot sizes and simulated fills can affect the realized weight.

Entry: At d ≤ max_drawdown set the long target to 100%. Start the first bar fully long.
Exit: At d > max_drawdown use max(min_position, 1 − (d − max_drawdown) × scale / max_drawdown). Recompute as the close or rolling high changes.
Indicators: Drawdown d is the magnitude of the close's relative shortfall from the rolling maximum close. Early windows use the available closes.
Position sizing: Long allocation ranges from 10% to 100% with the defaults.

strategies.summary: Reduces long exposure as the tested market falls from its rolling closing high.

strategies.bestOn: Tactical rotation among risk assets with a separate fallback
strategies.description: This dual-momentum variant ranks the risk assets by trailing return and applies a zero-return test to the winner. GLD is the default fallback.

zh.bestOn: 设有独立备用资产的战术轮动
zh.description: 这个双动量版本先按区间收益率排列风险资产，再判断第一名的收益率是否大于零。默认备用资产为 GLD。
notes: 组合使用 SPY、GLD、USO 与 EURUSD=X 均有完整行情的共同交易日。
在新月份首次观察到共同交易日时，使用上一条已完成行情确定目标仓位。目标在下一个可用收益区间生效。

Entry: 若最高可用收益率大于零，则将该风险资产的目标设为 100%。
Exit: 若最高收益率等于或低于零，则转为 100% GLD。若所有风险资产均缺少评分，则沿用前次目标。
Indicators: 计算 SPY、USO 和 EURUSD=X 的区间收盘价收益率。GLD 作为备用资产，不参与排名。
Inputs: 默认回看窗口为 252 个交易日，备用资产为 GLD。
Position sizing: 首次月度决策满足数据要求后，每次只持有一项资产。

zh.summary: 持有正动量最强的风险资产，否则切换至 GLD。

strategies.name: Dual Momentum
notes: The basket uses the common completed sessions of SPY, GLD, USO and EURUSD=X.
Set targets on the first common session observed in a new month using the preceding completed session. The target takes effect on the next available return interval.

Entry: If the highest available risk-asset return is strictly positive, set its target to 100%.
Exit: Set the target to 100% GLD when that return is zero or negative. Carry the prior target if every risk-asset score is unavailable.
Indicators: Calculate trailing closing-price returns for SPY, USO and EURUSD=X. GLD serves as the fallback and stays outside the ranking.
Inputs: Default lookback 252 sessions and safe asset GLD.
Position sizing: Hold one asset at a time after the first qualifying monthly decision.

strategies.summary: Holds the strongest positive-momentum risk asset or switches to GLD.
strategies.targetTiming: First observed session of a new month, using the prior observation; engine applies one-row lag.

strategies.description: This fixed two-average rule sets a fully long target whenever the 50-day simple moving average exceeds the 200-day average. All other bars target cash.

zh.description: 该规则使用两条固定窗口的简单均线。50 日均线高于 200 日均线时满仓做多，其余持有现金。
notes: 慢线需要 200 个完整收盘价才能得到第一个值。

Entry: 50 日均线高于 200 日均线时，目标为满仓多头。
Exit: 两线相等、快线低于慢线或均线未算出时，目标为现金。
Indicators: 对日收盘价分别计算 50 日和 200 日简单均线。
Inputs: 固定使用 50 日和 200 日收盘价简单均线。

zh.summary: 50 日收盘均线高于 200 日收盘均线时满仓做多。

strategies.name: Dual Moving Average
notes: The slow average first becomes available after 200 complete closes.

Entry: Set the target to 100% long while the 50-day average exceeds the 200-day average.
Exit: Use cash when the averages are equal, the fast average is below the slow average or the averages are unavailable.
Indicators: Calculate simple moving averages of the daily close over both windows.
Inputs: Fixed closing-price SMA windows of 50 and 200 days.

strategies.summary: Holds long while the 50-day closing SMA is above the 200-day SMA.

strategies.bestOn: Research on pairs with an adaptive hedge ratio
strategies.description: A one-coefficient Kalman filter estimates SPY's relationship to GLD in log prices. The strategy standardizes the fitted residual and updates the hedge weight while a trade is open.

zh.bestOn: 研究对冲比例随时间变化的配对
zh.description: 单系数卡尔曼滤波以对数价格估计 SPY 与 GLD 的关系。策略对拟合残差标准化，持仓期间随系数更新对冲权重。
notes: 站点回测以 SPY、GLD、USO、EURUSD=X、DBC、SLV、DBA、UNG、BTC-USD 与 ETH-USD 的共同完整行情为输入。界面以 SPY 标识这组组合。
实际交易对齐后的前两列，即站点配置中的 SPY 与 GLD。其余八项影响共同交易日历，目标权重均为零。
日度目标在下一个共同收益区间生效。z 分数或对冲比例缺失时沿用前次目标。

Entry: 预热 110 条观测后，z 低于 −1.5 时做多残差，z 高于 +1.5 时做空残差。
Exit: 在信号有效的观测上，z 高于 −0.3 时平多仓，z 低于 +0.3 时平空仓。达到 20 条观测的持仓上限也会在信号有效时平仓。
Indicators: 每日更新 beta 后，用 log(SPY) − beta × log(GLD) 得到残差，再按 60 个交易日的样本均值和样本标准差计算 z 分数。
Inputs: 默认过程噪声 Q 为 0.001，观测噪声 R 为 1，z 分数窗口为 60，入场门槛 1.5，退出门槛 0.3，持仓上限 20 条观测。
Position sizing: 多头用 [1, −beta]，空头用 [−1, beta]，均归一化至 100% 总敞口。

zh.summary: 用卡尔曼对冲比例和滚动 z 分数交易 SPY 与 GLD 的残差。

strategies.name: Dynamic Hedge Ratio Pairs
notes: The site backtest aligns SPY, GLD, USO, EURUSD=X, DBC, SLV, DBA, UNG, BTC-USD and ETH-USD on their common completed sessions. Its SPY display label identifies the basket.
The rule trades the first two aligned columns, SPY and GLD in the site configuration. The eight other inputs affect the common calendar and carry zero target weights.
Daily targets apply on the next common return interval. A missing z-score or hedge ratio carries the previous target.

Entry: After the 110-row warmup, z below −1.5 opens a long residual. z above +1.5 opens a short residual.
Exit: On valid signal rows, exit the long when z is above −0.3, or exit the short when z is below +0.3. The 20-observation holding limit also closes the position on a valid signal row.
Indicators: After updating beta each session, compute log(SPY) − beta × log(GLD) and use the 60-session sample mean and standard deviation to calculate its z-score.
Inputs: Default process noise Q 0.001, measurement noise R 1, z-score window 60, entry z-score 1.5, exit z-score 0.3 and holding limit 20 observations.
Position sizing: Normalize the signed weights [1, −beta] for long or [−1, beta] for short to 100% gross exposure.

strategies.summary: Trades a SPY–GLD residual with a daily Kalman hedge ratio and rolling z-score.

strategies.description: This daily adaptation of Elder Triple Screen goes long only when a positive MACD histogram, a close above the long EMA, a negative smoothed price-change proxy and a breakout above prior closes all hold on the same bar.

zh.description: 这是埃尔德三重滤网的日线改写。MACD 柱为正、收盘高于长期 EMA、平滑价格变化为负，并且收盘突破此前最高收盘价时，才做多。
notes: 回调指标只平滑收盘价变化，未使用成交量。各条件必须同时成立，策略可能长时间处于现金状态。

Entry: 趋势向上、回调代理为负且收盘突破门槛，当三者同时成立时做多。
Exit: 趋势条件失效时回到现金。趋势仍成立且没有新入场时，维持上一目标仓位。
Indicators: MACD 柱为正且收盘高于 50 根 EMA 时，趋势向上。
回调代理为收盘变化的 13 根 EMA。突破门槛为此前 20 根的最高收盘价。
Inputs: 默认参数为 MACD 12/26/9、长期 EMA 50、价格变化 EMA 13、突破回看期 20。
Position sizing: 目标为满仓做多或持有现金。

zh.summary: 日线只做多。趋势、回调和突破三个条件必须在同一收盘点成立。

strategies.name: Elder Triple Screen
notes: The pullback filter uses smoothed close changes without volume. The simultaneous filters can leave the strategy in cash for long periods.

Entry: Enter long when trend is up, the pullback proxy is negative and the current close exceeds the breakout threshold on the same bar.
Exit: Exit to cash when the trend filter fails. Otherwise hold the previous target unless a new entry triggers.
Indicators: Trend is up when the MACD histogram is positive and the close is above its 50-bar EMA.
The pullback proxy is the 13-bar EMA of close changes. The breakout threshold is the maximum close over the preceding 20 bars.
Inputs: Default: MACD 12/26/9, long EMA 50, price-change EMA 13, breakout lookback 20.

strategies.summary: A daily long-only rule requiring trend, pullback and breakout filters on the same close.

strategies.bestOn: Multi-asset trend allocation with fixed sleeves
strategies.description: This implementation applies a Faber-style trend rule to fixed equal sleeves. Each sleeve stays in cash while its asset fails the moving-average test.

zh.bestOn: 采用固定资产份额的多资产趋势配置
zh.description: 这个 Faber 风格版本把组合预先分成固定等权份额。资产低于或等于均线时，其对应份额持有现金。
notes: 组合使用 SPY、GLD、USO 与 EURUSD=X 均有完整行情的共同交易日。
在新月份首次观察到共同交易日时，使用上一条已完成行情确定目标仓位。目标在下一个可用收益区间生效。

Entry: 月度决策时，若最近一条已完成收盘价高于均线，则启用该资产对应的份额。
Exit: 收盘价低于或等于均线时，对应份额转为现金。
Indicators: 用各资产的收盘价计算其简单均线。
Inputs: 默认简单均线窗口为 200 个交易日，在日线数据上近似 10 个月趋势规则。
Position sizing: 四项资产各对应固定 25% 权重。只有一项通过时，配置 25%，其余 75% 维持现金。

zh.summary: 收盘价高于 200 日简单均线时，持有该资产对应的 25% 份额。

strategies.name: Faber TAA
notes: The basket uses the common completed sessions of SPY, GLD, USO and EURUSD=X.
Set targets on the first common session observed in a new month using the preceding completed session. The target takes effect on the next available return interval.

Entry: At a monthly decision, activate an asset's sleeve if its latest completed close is above its SMA.
Exit: Move the sleeve to cash when the close is at or below its SMA.
Indicators: Take the simple moving average of each asset's closing prices.
Inputs: Default SMA window 200 trading sessions, used as a daily-data approximation of the 10-month trend rule.
Position sizing: The four assets get one 25% sleeve each. When one asset qualifies, 25% is invested and the other 75% is cash.

strategies.summary: Holds each 25% asset sleeve only when its close exceeds its 200-session SMA.
strategies.targetTiming: First observed session of a new month, using the prior observation; engine applies one-row lag.

strategies.bestOn: Equity stress rules with a dedicated gold allocation
strategies.description: The daily rule holds an equal-weight basket outside stress and switches to GLD when either SPY stress measure triggers. It waits for a sustained clear period before restoring the risk basket.

zh.bestOn: 以黄金作为避险仓位的股市压力规则
zh.description: 日度规则在常态下等权持有风险组。任一 SPY 压力指标触发时转入 GLD，压力连续解除一段时间后再恢复原配置。
notes: 站点回测以 SPY、GLD、USO、EURUSD=X、DBC、SLV、DBA、UNG、BTC-USD 与 ETH-USD 的共同完整行情为输入。界面以 SPY 标识这组组合。
风险组包含 GLD 以外的九项资产。站点回测在下一个共同收益区间应用日度目标。

Entry: 预热 30 条观测后，任一指标超过门槛即将目标改为 100% GLD。
Exit: 从首条不再触发压力的观测开始计时。之后 10 条观测均未重新触发压力，则切回风险组。重新触发时重置计时。
Indicators: 用 SPY 自样本开始以来的最高收盘价计算回撤。用最近 20 个日收益率的样本标准差乘以 √252 得到年化波动率。
Inputs: 默认回撤门槛 5%，年化波动率门槛 25%，波动率窗口为 20 个日收益率，恢复间隔为 10 条观测。
Position sizing: 压力时仅持有 GLD，常态时等权持有其他九项资产。

zh.summary: SPY 回撤或波动率触发压力门槛时，将目标全数切换至黄金。

strategies.name: Flight to Quality
notes: The site backtest aligns SPY, GLD, USO, EURUSD=X, DBC, SLV, DBA, UNG, BTC-USD and ETH-USD on their common completed sessions. Its SPY display label identifies the basket.
The risk basket includes all nine non-GLD assets. The site applies the daily target to the next common return interval.

Entry: After the 30-row warmup, set the target to 100% GLD when either threshold is exceeded.
Exit: Start the recovery timer on the first clear observation and return to the risk basket 10 observations later if stress stays clear. A new trigger resets the timer.
Indicators: Measure drawdown from SPY's highest closing price observed so far. Use the sample standard deviation of 20 daily returns multiplied by √252 for annualized volatility.
Inputs: Default drawdown threshold 5%, annualized volatility threshold 25%, volatility lookback 20 daily returns, recovery timer 10 row intervals.
Position sizing: Use 100% GLD under stress and equal weights across the nine other assets outside stress.

strategies.summary: Switches fully into gold when SPY drawdown or volatility signals stress.

strategies.bestOn: Cross-asset rotation with a volatility filter
strategies.description: FX Carry is the historical name. The basket uses trailing price returns as a carry proxy across several asset classes. The rule uses closing prices and long positions only.

zh.bestOn: 带波动率过滤的跨资产轮动
zh.description: 外汇套息是历史名称。这个组合用多个资产类别的区间价格收益率作为套息代理指标，仅依据收盘价并持有多头。
notes: 组合使用 SPY、GLD、USO 与 EURUSD=X 均有完整行情的共同交易日。
在新月份首次观察到共同交易日时，使用上一条已完成行情确定目标仓位。目标在下一个可用收益区间生效。
收益率满足回看要求后即可排名。能计算组合平均波动率时才启用波动率过滤。

Entry: 调仓时选择可用收益率最高的两项，收益率为负也可入选。
Exit: 月度决策时，若平均年化波动率超过 20% 或没有可用排名，则持有现金。两次决策之间沿用上次目标。
Indicators: 按最近 20 个交易日的收盘价收益率排名。用各资产最近 60 个日收益率的样本标准差乘以 √252，再对所得年化波动率取平均。
Inputs: 默认回看 20 个交易日、取前 2 名、波动率窗口 60 个交易日、波动率门槛 20%。

zh.summary: 按近期价格收益率排名，在组合平均波动率允许时持有前两名。

strategies.name: FX Carry
notes: The basket uses the common completed sessions of SPY, GLD, USO and EURUSD=X.
Set targets on the first common session observed in a new month using the preceding completed session. The target takes effect on the next available return interval.
Ranking can start before the volatility history is available. The filter applies when a basket-average estimate exists.

Entry: At rebalance, select the two highest available returns. Returns can be negative.
Exit: At a monthly decision, go to cash if average annualized volatility exceeds 20% or there are no available ranking scores. Carry targets between monthly decisions.
Indicators: Rank trailing 20-session closing-price returns. Average the assets' 60-return sample standard deviations annualized by √252.
Inputs: Default lookback 20 sessions, top 2 assets, volatility lookback 60 sessions, volatility threshold 20%.
Position sizing: Equal long weights among selected assets.

strategies.summary: Ranks recent price returns and holds the top two when basket volatility permits.
strategies.targetTiming: First observed session of a new month, using the prior observation; engine applies one-row lag.

strategies.description: The fast and slow Hull moving averages are calculated from closing prices with integer-floor subwindows. The target is reassessed on every bar.

zh.description: 对收盘价计算快、慢赫尔均线，子窗口长度向下取整。每根 K 线重新判断目标仓位。
notes: 周期至少选 2，确保半周期长度有效。

Entry: 快线高于慢线时做多。开启 allow_short 后，快线低于慢线时做空。
Exit: 两线相等或尚未计算出两线时空仓。默认设置下，快线低于慢线也为空仓。
Indicators: HMA(n) 为 WMA(2 × WMA(收盘价, floor(n/2)) − WMA(收盘价, n), floor(√n))。
Position sizing: 默认满仓做多或持有现金。可选空头目标为 −100%。

zh.summary: 按两条赫尔均线的相对位置决定仓位。

strategies.name: HMA Crossover
notes: Use periods of at least 2 so the half-period has a valid length.

Entry: Go long when the fast HMA is above the slow HMA. Go short when the fast HMA is below the slow HMA if allow_short is enabled.
Exit: Go flat when the averages are equal or unavailable. With default settings, a fast HMA below the slow HMA also means cash.
Indicators: HMA(n) is WMA(2 × WMA(close, floor(n/2)) − WMA(close, n), floor(√n)).
Position sizing: 100% long or cash by default. Optional short target −100%.

strategies.summary: Sets direction from the relative values of two Hull moving averages.

strategies.description: HMM Regime Detection is the historical name. The backtest sorts a trailing return sample, fits separate Gaussian distributions to the two halves and classifies the recent mean return by their relative likelihoods.

zh.bestOn: 收益率状态差异明显的市场
zh.description: HMM 市场状态识别是历史名称。实际回测对滚动窗口内的收益率排序，将样本分为两半并分别拟合高斯分布，再比较近期平均收益在两组下的相对似然。
notes: 分类没有状态转移模型，高均值组的均值不一定为正。
源码读取 n_states，但始终分成两组。近期平均收益最多用 20 根 K 线。
预热结束后，若拟合窗口内有效收益率不足 50 个，则默认做多。

Entry: 预热后，似然比较选择高均值组时做多。
Exit: 似然比较选择低均值组时空仓。
Indicators: 将过去 lookback 根 K 线的日收益率排序，计算每一半的均值和总体标准差，标准差至少为 0.000001。
用最近 min(smooth_window, 20) 根的平均收益比较两组高斯似然。两个窗口均排除当前 K 线。

zh.summary: 用历史收益率拟合两组高斯分布，再判断近期收益属于哪一组。

strategies.name: HMM Regime Detection
notes: There is no transition model. Classification uses the higher-mean group, irrespective of whether its mean is positive.
The source reads n_states but always uses two groups. The recent mean uses at most 20 bars.
After warm-up, an estimation window with fewer than 50 valid returns defaults to a long target.

Entry: After warm-up, go long if the likelihood comparison selects the higher-mean group.
Exit: Set the target to cash when the comparison selects the lower-mean group.
Indicators: Sort the prior lookback daily returns. Estimate the mean and population standard deviation of each half, flooring the standard deviation at 0.000001.
Score the mean of the recent min(smooth_window, 20) returns under both Gaussian distributions. Exclude the current bar from both windows.
Inputs: Default: lookback = 252, smooth_window = 20 (capped at 20), two groups.

strategies.summary: Classifies recent returns using two Gaussian distributions fitted to past returns.

strategies.bestOn: Multi-asset allocation based on hierarchical clustering
strategies.description: Hierarchical Risk Parity sorts assets by the clustering tree and divides the sorted list recursively. Each split gives more weight to the lower-variance subcluster.

zh.bestOn: 采用层次聚类的多资产配置
zh.description: 层次风险平价按聚类树排列资产，并递归地将列表对半拆分。每次拆分时，估计方差较低的子组获得较高权重。
notes: 组合使用 SPY、GLD、USO 与 EURUSD=X 均有完整行情的共同交易日。
在新月份首次观察到共同交易日时，使用上一条已完成行情确定目标仓位。目标在下一个可用收益区间生效。
协方差不可用、任一资产方差为零，或聚类与权重计算失败时，回测使用等权配置。

Entry: 递归地将排序后的资产列表分成两半，按子组估计方差的倒数分配权重。
Exit: 在下一次满足数据要求的月度决策时重新计算目标。
Indicators: 将收益率相关系数转换为距离并聚类。对子组内部实行逆方差加权，以估计子组方差。
Inputs: 默认回看 60 个日收益率，采用单链接聚类。
Position sizing: 组合总目标权重为 100%，各权重回填到对应的原始资产。

zh.summary: 按收益率相关性聚类，再依据子组方差分配权重。

strategies.name: Hierarchical Risk Parity
notes: The basket uses the common completed sessions of SPY, GLD, USO and EURUSD=X.
Set targets on the first common session observed in a new month using the preceding completed session. The target takes effect on the next available return interval.
The backtest uses equal weights when covariance is unusable, any asset variance is zero, or clustering or weight calculation fails.

Entry: Split the ordered asset list in half recursively and allocate each split inversely to the estimated subcluster variances.
Exit: Recompute targets at the next eligible monthly decision.
Indicators: Convert return correlations into distances and cluster assets. Estimate subcluster variance using its internal inverse-variance weights.
Inputs: Default lookback 60 daily returns and single linkage.
Position sizing: Return a fully invested allocation with each result assigned to its original asset.

strategies.summary: Clusters assets by return correlation and distributes weight by cluster variance.
strategies.targetTiming: First observed session of a new month, using the prior observation; engine applies one-row lag.

strategies.bestOn: Markets with quiet periods and short-lived price dips
strategies.description: This strategy uses a low-volatility filter and a closing-price z-score. Hurst-Filtered Mean Reversion is its historical name. The signal uses realized volatility as the entry filter.

zh.bestOn: 有低波动阶段和短期价格回落的市场
zh.description: 策略以低波动率过滤入场，并用收盘价 z 分数识别偏离。Hurst 过滤均值回归是历史名称，实际入场过滤用的是已实现波动率。
notes: 波动率条件只过滤新入场。
归档源码含有一个 Hurst 计算函数，信号生成没有调用它。

Entry: z 分数低于 −1.5 且波动率低于自身均值时做多。
Exit: z 分数高于 −0.3，或从入场起经过 15 根 K 线时平仓。
Indicators: z 分数为收盘价减去滚动均值，再除以滚动样本标准差加一个很小的常量。
年化波动率取 vol_lookback 根 K 线的日收益率样本标准差乘 √252，再和该序列最近 lookback 根的均值比较。

zh.summary: 近期波动率低于自身均值时，买入显著低于均线的收盘价。

strategies.name: Hurst-Filtered Mean Reversion
notes: The filter applies only to new entries.
The archived source includes a Hurst calculation helper that the strategy does not call.

Entry: Go long when the z-score is below −1.5 and volatility is below its own moving average.
Exit: Exit when the z-score rises above −0.3 or 15 bars have elapsed since entry.
Indicators: Z-score: closing price minus its rolling average, divided by its rolling sample standard deviation plus a small offset.
Annualized volatility: sample standard deviation of daily returns over vol_lookback sessions, multiplied by √252. Compare it with its lookback-session moving average.
Inputs: Default: lookback = 40, vol_lookback = 20, entry_z = 1.5, exit_z = 0.3, max_hold = 15.

strategies.summary: Buys unusually low closes when recent volatility is below its own average.

strategies.description: The backtest builds the Ichimoku lines from rolling closing-price extremes. It goes long above the cloud when Tenkan is above Kijun and uses the lower cloud boundary and line relationship to exit.

zh.description: 回测用滚动窗口内的最高和最低收盘价计算一目均衡线。收盘价在云上且转换线高于基准线时做多，按云底和两线关系离场。
notes: 源码会计算迟行线，交易规则使用转换线、基准线与两条先行带。
默认参数下预热 78 根 K 线，期间空仓。

Entry: 收盘价高于云顶且转换线高于基准线时做多。
Exit: 收盘价低于云底或转换线不高于基准线时转为现金。未触发其他进出场条件时维持原仓位。
Indicators: 转换线和基准线为各自窗口内最高和最低收盘价的中点。
先行带 A 为转换线与基准线的中点，先行带 B 为 52 根 K 线内最高和最低收盘价的中点。当前云层使用 kijun 根 K 线之前计算的两条带。

zh.summary: 用收盘价计算一目云层，并用转换线与基准线关系确认。

strategies.name: Ichimoku Cloud
notes: The Chikou lagging line is calculated by the source helper. The trading rule uses Tenkan, Kijun and the two cloud spans.
The first 78 bars are flat at the default settings.

Entry: Go long when the close is above the cloud top and Tenkan is above Kijun.
Exit: Go to cash when the close is below the cloud bottom or Tenkan is at or below Kijun. Otherwise keep the previous target if the long condition does not trigger.
Indicators: Tenkan and Kijun are midpoints between the highest and lowest closes in their windows.
Span A is the midpoint of Tenkan and Kijun. Span B is the midpoint of highest and lowest closes over 52 bars. Both use values from kijun bars earlier to form the current cloud.

strategies.summary: Uses a close-based Ichimoku cloud and Tenkan–Kijun confirmation.

strategies.description: The current close updates the estimate. A one-sided recovery threshold closes the position, including recovery that overshoots zero.

zh.description: 当前收盘价更新估计值；用单侧回升阈值退出，超过零点的回升也会触发退出。
notes: 没有最长持仓期或独立止损；估计值依赖模型，并非已证实的内在价值。

Entry: 空仓时，z<−entry_z则做多。
Exit: 持仓时，z>−exit_z则退出，否则继续持有。
Indicators: 20个观测后，Q随此前20个对数收益的总体标准差调整；价格减估计值，再除以20行残差样本标准差（最低1e-8）。

zh.summary: 价格显著低于自适应卡尔曼估计时做多。

strategies.name: Kalman Filter Mean Reversion
notes: There is no maximum holding period or independent stop-loss. The estimate is model-dependent, not verified intrinsic value.

Entry: When flat, enter if z<−entry_z.
Exit: When held, exit if z>−exit_z; otherwise retain the position.
Indicators: After 20 observations, Q adapts to the population standard deviation of the prior 20 log returns. Divide price-minus-estimate by the 20-row residual sample standard deviation, floored at 1e-8.

strategies.summary: Buy negative deviations from an adaptive Kalman estimate.

strategies.description: The channel centers on a closing-price EMA and uses a simple average of OHLC true range for its width. Outside-band signals take precedence over midline exits.

zh.description: 通道中轨为收盘价指数均线，通道宽度采用 OHLC 真实波幅的简单均值。外轨突破优先于中轨离场判断。
notes: 启用空头后，收盘突破相反方向的外轨可直接反手。

Entry: 收盘高于上轨时做多。收盘低于下轨时，若开启 allow_short 则做空，否则空仓。
Exit: 收盘落在外轨之间时，持多且低于中轨则平仓，持空且高于中轨则平仓。等于中轨时保留原目标。
Indicators: 中轨为收盘价 EMA。ATR 为真实波幅的简单均值。上下轨为中轨 ± multiplier × ATR。
Position sizing: 默认满仓做多或持有现金。可选空头目标为 −100%。

zh.summary: 收盘突破肯特纳通道时交易，反向越过中轨时离场。

strategies.name: Keltner Channel Breakout
notes: A close beyond the opposite outer band can directly reverse an enabled long/short target.

Entry: Close above the upper band sets the long target. Below the lower band, set a short target if allow_short is enabled or go flat otherwise.
Exit: Within the outer bands, exit a long below the EMA and exit a short above it. At the EMA the prior target carries forward.
Indicators: Middle = EMA of closes. ATR = simple moving average of true range. Upper and lower bands = middle ± multiplier × ATR.
Position sizing: 100% long or cash by default. Optional short target −100%.

strategies.summary: Trades closing-price breakouts from a Keltner channel and exits across its midline.

strategies.description: The channel uses the fitted endpoint of a rolling linear regression and the dispersion of its price residuals. Each close is evaluated against the previous bar's channel.

zh.description: 在滚动窗口内拟合线性回归，以拟合线末端及价格残差波动构造通道。每根 K 线用收盘价和前一根通道比较。
notes: 外轨突破优先，可直接反手。
Pine 下载版默认与 Python 目标仓位一样包含多头和空头。关闭 Allow short 可测试只做多的变体。

Entry: 收盘严格高于前一根上轨时做多，严格低于前一根下轨时做空。
Exit: 在外轨内，持多且严格跌破前一根拟合末端时平仓，持空且严格越过前一根拟合末端时平仓。其余维持仓位。
Indicators: 对最近 period 个收盘价进行最小二乘拟合。通道为拟合线末端 ± std_dev × 残差总体标准差。
Position sizing: 满仓做多、满仓做空或持有现金。

zh.summary: 相对前一根线性回归通道做多或做空。

strategies.name: Linear Regression Channel
notes: Outer-band breakouts take precedence and can reverse a position directly.
The Pine download defaults to both directions as in the Python targets. Disable Allow short to test a long-only variant.

Entry: Close strictly above the previous upper band sets long. Close strictly below the previous lower band sets short.
Exit: Inside the outer bands, an existing long exits strictly below the previous fitted endpoint, and an existing short exits strictly above it. Otherwise hold.
Indicators: Fit ordinary least squares to the last period closes. Channel bands are the fitted endpoint ± std_dev × population standard deviation of residuals.

strategies.summary: Trades both directions against the previous rolling regression channel.

strategies.description: Each month, rank the basket by realized volatility. The reciprocal of each selected asset's positive volatility determines its share.

zh.bestOn: 按已实现波动率进行跨资产比较
zh.description: 每月按已实现波动率对组合成员排名。入选资产的正波动率用于计算其倒数权重。
notes: 组合使用 SPY、GLD、USO 与 EURUSD=X 均有完整行情的共同交易日。
在新月份首次观察到共同交易日时，使用上一条已完成行情确定目标仓位。目标在下一个可用收益区间生效。
波动率为零的资产可能占据一个排名名额，但权重为零，因此实际持仓可能少于两项。

Entry: 选择波动率估计值最低的两项资产。
Exit: 月度调仓时清空落选资产。入选资产均无正波动率时持有现金。
Indicators: 用收盘价日收益率的样本标准差衡量波动率。
Inputs: 默认波动率窗口为 60 个日收益率，取最低 2 名。
Position sizing: 对入选且有正波动率的资产，按波动率倒数归一化。

zh.summary: 轮动到波动率最低的至多两项资产，按逆波动率分配权重。

strategies.name: Low Volatility Rotation
notes: The basket uses the common completed sessions of SPY, GLD, USO and EURUSD=X.
Set targets on the first common session observed in a new month using the preceding completed session. The target takes effect on the next available return interval.
A zero-volatility estimate can occupy a ranking slot and receives zero weight. The rule can therefore hold fewer than two assets.

Entry: Select the two lowest available volatility estimates.
Exit: Clear dropped assets at rebalance. Go to cash if there is no positive volatility among the selected assets.
Indicators: Use the sample standard deviation of daily closing-price returns.
Inputs: Default volatility lookback 60 daily returns and top 2 assets.
Position sizing: Normalize inverse volatility across selected assets with positive estimates.

strategies.summary: Rotates into up to two low-volatility assets with inverse-volatility weights.
strategies.targetTiming: First observed session of a new month, using the prior observation; engine applies one-row lag.

strategies.description: A bullish crossover below the RSI overbought level or an already-bullish MACD with oversold RSI can enter. A bearish crossover exits without an oversold veto.

zh.description: RSI未超买时的MACD多头交叉，或MACD已处于多头且RSI超卖，都可入场；空头交叉退出不受RSI超卖限制。
notes: EMA-span RSI与Wilder RSI不同；没有时间止损，也不保证减少假信号。

Entry: 40行后：多头交叉且RSI<70，或MACD已高于信号线且RSI<30。
Exit: 空头交叉、RSI>80，或MACD不高于信号线且RSI>70时退出。
Indicators: MACD为递归EMA12−EMA26，信号线EMA9；RSI对涨跌额使用span14的EMA，分母加1e-10。

zh.summary: 结合MACD交叉或多头回调与EMA型RSI。

strategies.name: MACD + RSI Filter
notes: EMA-span RSI differs from Wilder RSI. There is no time stop or proven guarantee of fewer false signals.

Entry: After 40 rows: bullish crossover AND RSI<70, OR MACD already above signal AND RSI<30.
Exit: Bearish crossover, RSI>80, or MACD not above signal while RSI>70.
Indicators: MACD uses recursive EMA12−EMA26 and EMA9 signal. RSI uses EMA span14 of gains/losses with denominator offset1e-10.
Inputs: macd_fast=12, macd_slow=26, macd_signal=9, rsi_period=14, rsi_overbought=70, rsi_oversold=30, rsi_extreme=80.

strategies.summary: Combine MACD crossings or bullish pullbacks with EMA-based RSI.

strategies.description: The strategy uses the relative position of the closing-price MACD and its signal line after the warm-up.

zh.description: 预热后按收盘价 MACD 和信号线的相对位置决定仓位。
notes: 默认前 35 根空仓，首根满足预热要求的 K 线即可触发多头。

Entry: 从零起计的第 slow + signal 根开始，MACD 高于信号线即做多。
Exit: 预热期或 MACD 不高于信号线时为空仓。
Indicators: MACD 为收盘价 EMA(fast) 减 EMA(slow)。信号线为 MACD 的 EMA(signal)。

zh.summary: MACD 位于信号线上方时做多。

strategies.name: MACD Strategy
notes: With defaults the first 35 bars remain flat. The rule can go long on its first eligible bar.

Entry: From zero-based bar slow + signal onward, set long whenever MACD exceeds its signal line.
Exit: Use cash before warm-up or when MACD is at or below the signal line.
Indicators: MACD = closing EMA(fast) − EMA(slow). Signal line = EMA(MACD, signal).

strategies.summary: Holds long when MACD is above its signal line.

strategies.description: Money Flow Index Reversion is the historical name. The backtest uses a price-only RSI variant calculated from simple averages of closing-price gains and losses.

zh.bestOn: 短期反转反复出现的市场
zh.description: 资金流量指标回归是历史名称。实际回测使用仅基于收盘价的 RSI 变体，分别对上涨额和下跌额取简单均值。
notes: 指标和买卖规则均不读取成交量。

Entry: 指标低于 30 时做多。
Exit: 指标高于 50，或从入场起经过 15 根 K 线时平仓。
Indicators: 对最近 period 根 K 线的收盘价上涨额和下跌额分别求简单均值。指标等于 100 − 100 ÷（1 + 平均上涨额 ÷（平均下跌额 + ε））。

zh.summary: 用收盘价计算简单均线 RSI，指标进入超卖区时做多。

strategies.name: Money Flow Index Reversion
notes: Volume plays no part in the indicator or the entry and exit rules.

Entry: Go long when the oscillator is below 30.
Exit: Exit when it rises above 50 or 15 bars have elapsed since entry.
Indicators: Use simple averages of positive and negative closing-price changes over period bars. The oscillator is 100 − 100 ÷ (1 + average gain ÷ (average loss + ε)).

strategies.summary: Buys oversold readings on an SMA-based RSI computed from closing prices.

strategies.description: First calculate the fully invested minimum-variance solution that permits negative weights. The default then clips negative weights and rescales the remaining positions, so the long-only result can differ from the constrained optimum.

zh.bestOn: 比较基于协方差的低方差配置
zh.description: 先求出允许负权重且总权重为 1 的最小方差解。默认将负权重截为零，再对剩余仓位归一化，所得多头组合可能偏离带约束的最优解。
notes: 组合使用 SPY、GLD、USO 与 EURUSD=X 均有完整行情的共同交易日。
在新月份首次观察到共同交易日时，使用上一条已完成行情确定目标仓位。目标在下一个可用收益区间生效。
可选参数 allow_short 可保留负权重。协方差无法使用或无法求逆时，使用等权配置。

Entry: 将协方差矩阵的逆乘以全 1 向量，并缩放至总权重为 1。
Exit: 在下一次满足数据要求的月度决策时重新计算。零权重会清空原持仓。
Indicators: 将样本协方差矩阵年化，并对其对角元素各加 0.000001。
Inputs: 默认窗口为 60 个日收益率，allow_short 关闭，对角线正则项为 0.000001。
Position sizing: 默认将负权重设为零，再次归一化。

zh.summary: 用协方差近似求解仅做多的最小方差配置。

strategies.name: Minimum Variance
notes: The basket uses the common completed sessions of SPY, GLD, USO and EURUSD=X.
Set targets on the first common session observed in a new month using the preceding completed session. The target takes effect on the next available return interval.
The optional allow_short setting keeps negative weights. The rule uses equal weights if covariance is unusable or inversion fails.

Entry: Multiply its inverse by the all-ones vector and scale the result to sum to one.
Exit: Recompute at the next eligible monthly decision. Zero weights clear former positions.
Indicators: Annualize the sample covariance matrix and add 0.000001 to each diagonal entry.
Inputs: Default lookback 60 daily returns, allow_short disabled and diagonal regularization 0.000001.
Position sizing: By default, clip negative weights to zero and normalize again.

strategies.summary: Uses a covariance-based approximation to long-only minimum variance.
strategies.targetTiming: First observed session of a new month, using the prior observation; engine applies one-row lag.

strategies.bestOn: Single-asset momentum with exposure scaled by baseline losses
strategies.description: The drawdown tracker follows a hypothetical long-or-cash momentum rule on the same instrument. Its equity curve measures the stress of that baseline for position sizing.

zh.bestOn: 根据基准策略回撤调整敞口的单资产动量
zh.description: 回撤跟踪的是同一品种上一个假设的多头或现金动量规则。用该基准的权益曲线回撤决定仓位。
notes: 站点对各品种单独回测，并在下一个可用收益区间应用日度目标。
旧参数 recovery_pct 不影响策略。当前动量和回撤满足原有条件时，目标仓位可以恢复。
Pine 示例在目标非零且实际仓位与目标相差超过权益的 0.1% 时再平衡。

Entry: 预热 272 条观测后，当动量为正且基准回撤不超过 10% 时，目标为 100%。
Exit: 当前动量等于或低于零，或基准回撤超过 20% 时，目标为现金。
Indicators: 上一条观测的动量为正时，将当日价格收益计入基准权益曲线。用这条曲线迄今最高值计算回撤。
Inputs: 默认动量窗口为 252 个交易日，初级回撤门槛 10%，严重回撤门槛 20%，达到严重门槛时对应仓位 50%。
Position sizing: 当动量为正且回撤大于 10% 但不超过 20% 时，目标由 100% 线性减至 50%。

zh.summary: 当基准动量规则出现回撤时，缩减多头敞口。

strategies.name: Momentum Crash Protection
notes: The site evaluates each instrument separately and applies the daily target to the next available return interval.
The legacy recovery_pct setting has no effect. Exposure can rise again as the same momentum and drawdown conditions improve.
The Pine example uses a 0.1% equity gap before rebalancing a nonzero target.

Entry: After the 272-row warmup, positive momentum and baseline drawdown of 10% or less set the target to 100%.
Exit: Go to cash if current momentum is zero or negative, or if baseline drawdown is greater than 20%.
Indicators: Accumulate the instrument's daily returns on rows where prior momentum was positive. Measure drawdown from that baseline equity curve's highest level so far.
Inputs: Default momentum lookback 252 sessions, first drawdown threshold 10%, severe threshold 20% and lower exposure at the severe threshold 50%.
Position sizing: For positive momentum and a drawdown above 10% through 20%, scale linearly from 100% to 50%.

strategies.summary: Reduces long exposure when the underlying momentum rule experiences a drawdown.

strategies.bestOn: Baskets with a range of momentum and risk profiles
strategies.description: The strategy standardizes each factor across assets, combines the scores and gives every scored asset a positive target weight. Higher composite scores get more weight.

zh.bestOn: 动量与风险特征各异的跨资产组合
zh.description: 对各因子做横截面标准化并合成评分。所有具有综合评分的资产均获得正权重，分数越高，权重越大。
notes: 站点回测以 SPY、GLD、USO、EURUSD=X、DBC、SLV、DBA、UNG、BTC-USD 与 ETH-USD 的共同完整行情为输入。界面以 SPY 标识这组组合。
在新月份首次观察到共同交易日时，使用上一条已完成行情确定目标仓位。目标在下一个可用收益区间生效。
默认回撤指标包含两个 252 个交易日的滚动窗口，计入第一条价格后需 503 条观测才有首个值。

Entry: 月度决策时对所有具有综合评分的资产配置仓位。
Exit: 在满足数据要求的月度决策时更新目标。若所有资产均无综合评分，则沿用上次目标。
Indicators: 价值因子取价格除以简单均线后的负值。动量因子取区间收益率。
质量因子取负年化波动率和负最大回撤绝对值的平均。先基于滚动价格高点计算回撤，再取窗口内最大回撤。
分别计算各因子的横截面样本 z 分数，再按权重相加。
Inputs: 默认价值和回撤窗口均为 252 个交易日，动量窗口为 126 个交易日，波动率窗口为 60 个日收益率，因子权重为 30% / 40% / 30%。
Position sizing: 各综合评分减去最低评分，再加 0.1 并归一化。无评分资产权重为零。

zh.summary: 用价格相对均线、动量和质量的综合评分分配组合权重。

strategies.name: Multi-Factor Composite
notes: The site backtest aligns SPY, GLD, USO, EURUSD=X, DBC, SLV, DBA, UNG, BTC-USD and ETH-USD on their common completed sessions. Its SPY display label identifies the basket.
Set targets on the first common session observed in a new month using the preceding completed session. The target takes effect on the next available return interval.
The default drawdown calculation uses two rolling 252-session windows. It provides its first value after 503 observations, including the first price observation.

Entry: At an eligible monthly decision, allocate to every asset with a composite score.
Exit: Recalculate targets at each eligible rebalance. Carry the previous target while no composite scores are available.
Indicators: Value is negative price divided by its SMA. Momentum is the trailing return.
Quality averages negative annualized volatility and negative absolute maximum drawdown. Compute drawdowns from rolling price peaks and take the rolling worst drawdown.
Compute cross-sectional sample z-scores before combining the factors.
Inputs: Default value and drawdown lookbacks 252 sessions, momentum lookback 126 sessions, volatility lookback 60 returns, factor weights 30% / 40% / 30%.
Position sizing: Subtract the smallest composite score, add 0.1 to each scored asset and normalize. Assets without a score receive zero weight.

strategies.summary: Weights the basket with a blend of price-to-average, momentum and quality scores.
strategies.targetTiming: First observed session of a new month, using the prior observation; engine applies one-row lag.

strategies.description: Fit an intercept and lag coefficient to the previous 60 closes, excluding the decision close. Only a valid mean-reverting fit with an eligible half-life can hold a position.

zh.description: 对前60个收盘价拟合截距与滞后系数，不包含当前决策收盘价；只有有效且半衰期合格的均值回归拟合才允许持仓。
notes: OLS归一化修正会改变旧估计；历史证据必须标明实际规则版本。没有固定持仓时限止损。

Entry: 拟合有效、半衰期在闭区间[1,30]内，且当前z<−1.5时做多。
Exit: z>−.5、拟合失效或半衰期离开允许区间时退出。
Indicators: OLS斜率使用一致的协方差/方差归一化。0<b<1时，theta=−log(b)，mu=a/(1−b)，半衰期=log(2)/theta；z使用拟合的均衡波动率。

zh.summary: 用拟合的均值回归半衰期筛选OU偏离交易。

strategies.name: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Mean Reversion
notes: The corrected OLS normalization changes prior estimates; historical evidence must identify its actual rule version. No fixed holding-time stop is implemented.

Entry: Valid fit, half-life within inclusive[1,30], and current z<−1.5.
Exit: Exit if z>−.5, the fit becomes invalid, or its half-life leaves the allowed range.
Indicators: OLS slope uses matched covariance/variance normalization. For0<b<1, theta=−log(b), mu=a/(1−b), half-life=log(2)/theta; z uses fitted equilibrium volatility.

strategies.summary: Use a fitted mean-reversion half-life to gate OU deviation trades.

strategies.bestOn: Research on mean reversion in the SPY–GLD spread
strategies.description: This fixed pair uses equal-dollar long and short legs. It enters on extreme z-scores and holds until the configured exit condition or holding limit is reached.

zh.bestOn: 研究 SPY 与 GLD 价差的均值回归
zh.description: 固定使用 SPY 和 GLD，分别持有等金额的多头和空头。z 分数达到极值时入场，直到触发退出条件或达到持仓上限。
notes: 组合使用 SPY 与 GLD 的共同完整交易日。站点在下一个共同收益区间应用日度目标。

Entry: 空仓时，z 低于 −2 则做多 SPY、做空 GLD。z 高于 +2 则做空 SPY、做多 GLD。
Exit: 当 z 的绝对值不大于退出区间半宽，或持仓计数达到 20 时平仓。默认区间宽度为零，要求 z 恰好为零。若 z 只改变符号，仓位可能继续持有。
Indicators: 用 log(SPY) − log(GLD) 作为价差，并按滚动样本均值和样本标准差计算 z 分数。
Inputs: 默认窗口为 60 个交易日，入场 z 门槛为 2，退出区间半宽为 0，最长持仓计数为 20 条观测。
Position sizing: 两条腿方向相反，各占权益 50%，净金额敞口为零，总敞口为 100%。

zh.summary: 按 SPY 与 GLD 对数价格比的滚动 z 分数，在极端偏离时开仓。

strategies.name: SPY-GLD Pair
notes: The basket uses the common completed sessions of SPY and GLD. The site applies each daily target to the next common return interval.

Entry: When flat, z below −2 opens long SPY and short GLD. z above +2 opens short SPY and long GLD.
Exit: Close when absolute z is at or below the exit band or the holding count reaches 20. A default zero-width band requires z to equal zero. A sign change can leave the trade open.
Indicators: Compute log(SPY) − log(GLD) and standardize it using its rolling sample mean and standard deviation.
Inputs: Default lookback 60 sessions, entry z-score 2, exit band 0 and maximum holding count 20 observations.
Position sizing: Each leg is 50% of equity in opposite directions, for zero net dollar exposure and 100% gross.

strategies.summary: Trades extremes in the rolling z-score of the SPY/GLD log price ratio.

strategies.description: The OHLC rule begins in an uptrend. The SAR accelerates toward the current trend extreme, with its value constrained by previous bars' lows or highs.

zh.description: OHLC 规则从上涨状态开始。SAR 朝当前趋势极值加速移动，并受前两根 K 线高低价约束。
notes: 当根最高价或最低价可触发翻转，即使收盘位于重置后 SAR 的另一侧。

Entry: 第一根设为多头。下降状态中，若当前最高价严格越过 SAR 则翻多。
Exit: 上涨状态中，当前最低价严格跌破 SAR 则翻为空头状态，默认持有现金。翻转时重置加速因子。
Indicators: 首根最低价作为初始 SAR，首根最高价作为初始趋势极值。
SAR 按加速因子与其至趋势极值的距离递推，再用前两根最低价或最高价约束。
Position sizing: 默认满仓做多或持有现金。可选空头目标为 −100%。

zh.summary: 用每根 K 线的最高价或最低价判断抛物线 SAR 趋势是否翻转。

strategies.name: Parabolic SAR
notes: The bar's high or low can trigger a reversal even if the close finishes on the other side of the reset SAR.

Entry: Target long from the first bar. In a downtrend, flip to long if the current high is strictly above SAR.
Exit: In an uptrend, flip down if the current low is strictly below SAR. Default targets go to cash in a downtrend. A reversal resets the acceleration factor.
Indicators: Seed SAR with the first low and the trend extreme with the first high.
Advance SAR by the acceleration factor times the distance to the trend extreme, then constrain it with the prior two bar lows or highs.
Position sizing: 100% long or cash by default. Optional short target −100%.

strategies.summary: Uses each bar's high or low to update or reverse the Parabolic SAR trend.

strategies.description: The close must exceed its 200-day simple moving average and annualized 60-day return volatility must be below 25%. The model moves between full long exposure and cash.

zh.description: 收盘价必须高于 200 日简单均线，且 60 日年化收益率波动低于 25%。仓位在满仓做多和现金之间切换。
notes: 两项条件均为严格比较，等于任一门槛时空仓。

Entry: 收盘价高于均线且年化波动率低于 25% 时做多。
Exit: 任一条件不满足时空仓。
Indicators: 200 日收盘价简单均线。
60 日日收益率样本标准差乘 √252。
Inputs: 固定值：趋势均线 200 日，波动率窗口 60 日，阈值为年化 25%。

zh.summary: 长期趋势与波动率两个条件同时满足时做多。

strategies.name: Regime Switch
notes: Both tests use strict inequalities. The rule goes to cash at either boundary.

Entry: Go long when the close is above the SMA and annualized volatility is below 25%.
Exit: Go to cash whenever either condition fails.
Indicators: 200-day closing-price SMA.
60-day sample standard deviation of daily returns multiplied by √252.
Inputs: Fixed: trend SMA = 200 days, volatility lookback = 60 days, volatility threshold = 25% annualized.

strategies.summary: Holds the market when the long-term trend and volatility filters both pass.

strategies.description: Residual Momentum is the historical label. This single-series rule does not load SPY or estimate beta: it subtracts a 60-observation mean from each return, then sums earlier demeaned returns.

zh.description: 残差动量是历史名称；此单序列规则不加载SPY或估计beta，而是从每期收益减去60个观测的自身均值，再累计较早的去均值收益。
notes: 默认完整指标最早在从0计数的第311行可用；该代理不剔除市场暴露，也不能据此认定alpha。

Entry: 残差和为正且指标历史充分时做多。
Exit: 残差和非正或不可用时空仓。
Indicators: r为单期收盘收益；residual=r−SMA60(r)；将residual滞后skip_period行，再累计momentum_lookback−skip_period行。
Inputs: momentum_lookback=252，skip_period=21；滚动均值固定60；beta_window=252虽被接收但未使用。

zh.summary: 按收益减去自身滚动均值后的动量交易。

strategies.name: Residual Momentum
notes: Default full indicator history first exists at zero-based row311. This proxy does not remove market exposure or establish alpha.

Entry: Long when the residual sum is positive and indicator history is available.
Exit: Cash when the sum is nonpositive or unavailable.
Indicators: r=one-row close return; residual=r−SMA60(r). Sum momentum_lookback−skip_period residuals after shifting them skip_period rows.
Inputs: momentum_lookback=252, skip_period=21; trailing mean fixed60; beta_window=252 is accepted but unused.

strategies.summary: Trade momentum of returns demeaned by their own trailing average.

strategies.bestOn: Multi-asset allocations with an explicit gold sleeve
strategies.description: The rule averages scores from volatility percentile, the moving-average trend and trailing momentum. It selects one of three daily allocations.

zh.bestOn: 以黄金作为独立避险仓位的多资产组合
zh.description: 给波动率百分位、均线趋势和区间动量分别打分，再取平均值。每日选择三种配置之一。
notes: 站点回测以 SPY、GLD、USO、EURUSD=X、DBC、SLV、DBA、UNG、BTC-USD 与 ETH-USD 的共同完整行情为输入。界面以 SPY 标识这组组合。
风险组包含 GLD 以外的所有配置资产。站点回测在下一个共同收益区间应用目标仓位。
旧参数 vol_threshold 不影响策略。波动率通过百分位参与评分。

Entry: 预热 262 条观测后，平均分高于 0.3 时将 100% 配置给风险组，低于 −0.3 时将 100% 配置给 GLD。
Exit: 每日重新判断。平均分在两门槛之间或恰好等于门槛时，风险组和 GLD 各占 50%。
Indicators: 波动率百分位低于 30 加 1，高于 70 减 1。收盘价高于均线加 1，否则减 1。
区间收益率大于 0 加 1，低于 −5% 减 1。对可用分项评分取平均。
Inputs: 默认波动率窗口为 20 个日收益率，百分位窗口为 252 个波动率估计，趋势均线为 50 个交易日，动量窗口为 63 个交易日。
Position sizing: 风险组的分配在九项成员之间等分。

zh.summary: 用三个 SPY 信号在风险资产、平衡组合和黄金之间切换。

strategies.name: Risk-On/Risk-Off Switch
notes: The site backtest aligns SPY, GLD, USO, EURUSD=X, DBC, SLV, DBA, UNG, BTC-USD and ETH-USD on their common completed sessions. Its SPY display label identifies the basket.
The risk group consists of every configured asset except GLD. The published results apply targets to the next common return interval.
The legacy vol_threshold parameter has no effect. Volatility enters the score through its percentile.

Entry: After the 262-row warmup, an average above 0.3 sets 100% to the risk group. An average below −0.3 sets 100% to GLD.
Exit: Recalculate daily. Scores between those thresholds, including equality, split 50% risk and 50% GLD.
Indicators: Volatility percentile below 30 adds 1 and above 70 subtracts 1. A close above the SMA adds 1 and otherwise subtracts 1.
Momentum above 0 adds 1 and below −5% subtracts 1. Average the available component scores.
Inputs: Default volatility lookback 20 daily returns, volatility percentile lookback 252 estimates, trend SMA 50 sessions and momentum lookback 63 sessions.
Position sizing: Divide the risk allocation equally among its nine members.

strategies.summary: Switches among risk-on, balanced and gold allocations using three SPY signals.

strategies.description: The default is an approximation to equal risk budgeting. Each asset's trailing volatility determines its weight, and correlations can still affect the actual risk contributions.

zh.bestOn: 按逆波动率分配的多资产组合
zh.description: 默认规则用逆波动率近似等风险预算。资产的区间波动率决定其权重，资产间相关性仍会影响实际风险贡献。
notes: 组合使用 SPY、GLD、USO 与 EURUSD=X 均有完整行情的共同交易日。
在新月份首次观察到共同交易日时，使用上一条已完成行情确定目标仓位。目标在下一个可用收益区间生效。
基于协方差的迭代为可选模式，默认关闭。该模式可能产生空头权重，各资产的风险贡献也可能不同。

Entry: 月度决策时，取各资产波动率的倒数并归一化可用权重。
Exit: 在下一次满足数据要求的月度决策时更新目标。
Indicators: 用日收益率的样本标准差计算年化波动率。默认模式下，波动率为零或缺失时，在有可用平均值的情况下用各资产波动率的平均值填补。
Inputs: 默认窗口为 60 个日收益率，full_optimization 关闭。
Position sizing: 默认配置对波动率较低的资产赋予较高权重。

zh.summary: 默认按逆波动率为组合分配权重。

strategies.name: Risk Parity
notes: The basket uses the common completed sessions of SPY, GLD, USO and EURUSD=X.
Set targets on the first common session observed in a new month using the preceding completed session. The target takes effect on the next available return interval.
The optional covariance-based iteration is disabled by default. Its result can include short weights and can miss equal risk contributions.

Entry: At the monthly decision, divide by each asset's volatility and normalize the available weights.
Exit: Refresh the target at the next eligible monthly decision.
Indicators: Estimate annualized volatility from sample return standard deviations. In the default branch substitute the average of available volatility estimates for zero or missing estimates when that average is usable.
Inputs: Default lookback 60 daily returns, full_optimization disabled.
Position sizing: The default allocation gives larger weights to less volatile assets.

strategies.summary: Weights the portfolio by inverse volatility by default.
strategies.targetTiming: First observed session of a new month, using the prior observation; engine applies one-row lag.

strategies.description: Each close, the rule uses 14 daily changes in closing price to calculate RSI from simple averages. An oversold reading sets the target for the next return interval to fully long.

zh.description: 每个交易日收盘后，策略用最近 14 日收盘价变动额的简单均值计算 RSI。出现超卖读数时，下一个收益区间的目标为满仓做多。
notes: 连续出现超卖读数时，仓位可以维持多个交易日。
RSI 缺失时空仓，平均下跌额为零也会导致 RSI 缺失。

Entry: RSI 低于 30 时将目标设为多头。
Exit: RSI 达到 30 或无法计算时将目标设为现金。
Indicators: 分别取 14 日收盘价上涨额和下跌额的简单均值，得到 RSI。
Inputs: 固定值：RSI 窗口为 14，超卖门槛为 30。

zh.summary: 14 日简单均线 RSI 低于 30 时做多。

strategies.name: RSI Mean Reversion
notes: Consecutive oversold readings can keep the position open for multiple sessions.
A missing RSI reading, including when average loss is zero, produces a flat target.

Entry: Set the long target whenever RSI is below 30.
Exit: Set the target to cash whenever RSI is at least 30 or unavailable.
Indicators: RSI from simple averages of positive and negative closing-price changes over 14 sessions.

strategies.summary: Takes a long position only while the 14-day SMA-based RSI is below 30.

strategies.description: A fixed monthly seasonal rule evaluated on each observed close; the target applies to the subsequent return interval.

zh.bestOn: 股票指数的季节性对照
zh.description: 每个观测收盘后按固定月份判断季节性仓位，目标用于下一个收益区间。
notes: SPY是目录设定的目标品种；函数本身接受传入的单品种价格序列。没有使用事件日历。

Entry: 观测月份在持仓集合内时，目标设为1。
Exit: 其他月份目标设为0。
Indicators: 输入日期的月份。
Inputs: 固定持仓月份：11、12、1、2、3、4；没有可配置数值参数。

zh.summary: 11月至次年4月目标做多，5月至10月持有现金。

strategies.name: Monthly Seasonality
notes: SPY is the intended catalogue instrument; the function itself accepts any supplied single price series. No event calendar is used.

Entry: Set target1 when the observation is in an active month.
Exit: Set target0 in all other months.
Indicators: Month of the input date.
Inputs: Fixed active months:11,12,1,2,3,4. No configurable numeric parameters.

strategies.summary: Target long in November–April and cash in May–October.

strategies.description: This is a close-only stochastic approximation. D is calculated but does not confirm trades; its period contributes to warmup.

zh.description: 这是仅用收盘价的随机指标近似；D虽被计算但不确认交易，其周期用于预热长度。
notes: 收盘价区间为零时K=0，可能触发入场；没有使用OHLC最高/最低价。

Entry: 经过k_period+d_period行后，K<20时入场。
Exit: K>50或持仓间隔≥20个观测时退出。
Indicators: K=100×(收盘价−滚动最低收盘价)/(滚动最高收盘价−最低收盘价+1e-10)；D=SMA3(K)。

zh.summary: 收盘价区间随机指标K超卖时做多，高于50或持仓20个观测后退出。

strategies.name: Stochastic Oscillator Reversion
notes: A zero close range gives K=0 and can trigger an entry; no OHLC highs/lows are used.

Entry: After k_period+d_period rows, enter when K<20.
Exit: Exit when K>50 or holding age≥20 observations.
Indicators: K=100×(close−rolling lowest close)/(rolling highest close−lowest close+1e-10); D=SMA3(K).

strategies.summary: Buy an oversold close-range stochastic K and exit above50 or at 20 bars.

strategies.description: The base signal is the close above a simple moving average. A separate stop compares the current close with the entry close, and a stop-triggered exit starts the cooldown.

zh.description: 基础信号为收盘价高于简单均线。另用当前收盘和入场收盘计算止损，只有止损离场会启动冷却期。
notes: 若在第 t 根止损，第 t + cooldown 根符合趋势条件时即可重新入场。
止损只在收盘时判断，亏损可能超过触发阈值。

Entry: 经过 ma_period 根预热后，空仓、冷却期结束且收盘高于均线时做多。
Exit: 当前收盘相对入场收盘回报严格低于 −stop_pct 时先触发止损，启动冷却。未触发止损且收盘不高于均线时也退出，但不启动冷却。
Indicators: 用收盘价计算 SMA(ma_period)，记录设立多头目标时的收盘价作为止损基准。

zh.summary: 收盘均线趋势策略，带入场价止损与止损后冷却。

strategies.name: Stop Loss Overlay
notes: After a stop on bar t, entry can resume on bar t + cooldown if the trend condition passes.
The stop is evaluated at the close. The threshold is a signal level and losses can exceed it.

Entry: After ma_period bars, enter from cash when the close exceeds the SMA and the cooldown has expired.
Exit: Exit first if the close-to-entry return is strictly below −stop_pct. This starts cooldown. Otherwise exit when close is at or below SMA without cooldown.
Indicators: Compute SMA(ma_period) from closes. Keep the close that established the long target as the stop reference.

strategies.summary: Runs a closing-price trend rule with an entry-relative stop and stop-only cooldown.

strategies.description: The backtest uses OHLC bars and measures the bands from the high–low midpoint. Full long exposure follows the uptrend state.

zh.description: 回测用 OHLC 数据和当根高低价中点计算通道。上涨状态中满仓做多。
notes: 生产回测调用 OHLC 分支。Python 源码还包含单独的收盘价近似分支。

Entry: 经过 atr_period + 3 根预热后，收盘高于高低价中点即初始化为上涨状态，否则为下降状态。之后下降状态下收盘高于上轨时转上涨。
Exit: 上涨状态下收盘低于下轨时转下降，其余维持状态。
Indicators: ATR 为 OHLC 真实波幅的指数均值，跨度为 atr_period。原始轨道为（最高价 + 最低价）÷2 ± multiplier × ATR。
用上一根收盘价和前值更新或重置轨道。
Position sizing: 默认满仓做多或持有现金。可选空头目标为 −100%。

zh.summary: 用真实波幅的指数均值构建超级趋势轨道。

strategies.name: Supertrend
notes: The production backtest uses the OHLC branch. The Python helper also has a separate close-only approximation.

Entry: After atr_period + 3 bars, initialize as an uptrend if the close exceeds (high + low)/2, else as a downtrend. Later a close above the upper trailing band turns a downtrend upward.
Exit: A close below the lower trailing band turns an uptrend downward. Otherwise preserve direction.
Indicators: ATR is an EMA of OHLC true range with span atr_period. Raw bands are (high + low)/2 ± multiplier × ATR.
Trail or reset the bands with the previous trailing bands and previous close.
Position sizing: 100% long or cash by default. Optional short target −100%.

strategies.summary: Sets trend direction from trailing bands built with EMA-smoothed true range.

strategies.description: Re-evaluates momentum at every observed close. It has no21-row/monthly rebalance scheduler or macro-event filter.

zh.bestOn: 长期动量对照
zh.description: 每个观测收盘后重新判断动量；没有21行/月度调仓计划或宏观事件过滤。
notes: 252个观测不一定等于12个日历月；没有事件回避或按月锁定持仓。

Entry: 动量>0时目标设为1。
Exit: 动量≤0或不可用时目标设为0。
Indicators: 动量=当前收盘价/252个观测前收盘价−1。
Inputs: 固定回看252个观测；config不改变该规则。

zh.summary: 固定252个观测的收益为正时，目标做多。

strategies.name: Time-Series Momentum
notes: 252 observations need not equal12 calendar months. No event skip or stateful monthly holding is implemented.

Entry: Target1 when momentum>0.
Exit: Target0 when momentum≤0 or unavailable.
Indicators: Momentum=close/close252 observations earlier−1.
Inputs: Fixed lookback252; config does not alter this rule.

strategies.summary: Target long while the fixed252-observation return is positive.

strategies.description: The strategy enters above a closing-price moving average. Its trailing stop uses the highest close since entry and an ATR approximation based on absolute changes between successive closes.

zh.description: 收盘价高于均线时进场。移动止损根据入场以来的最高收盘价计算，ATR 使用相邻收盘价变动绝对值的均值近似。
notes: 止损只在收盘时判断，持仓期间止损线可上移或保持原位。

Entry: 空仓时，若收盘价高于入场均线则做多，并用入场收盘价初始化止损线。
Exit: 收盘价低于更新后的止损线时转为现金。
Indicators: 入场均线为 20 日收盘价均线。波幅为相邻收盘价变动绝对值的 14 日简单均值。
止损线取前值与候选值中较高者。候选值为入场以来最高收盘价减去 2.5 倍波幅。

zh.summary: 用入场以来最高收盘价与波幅设置只升不降的移动止损。

strategies.name: Trailing Stop Strategy
notes: The stop is evaluated at the close. It can rise or stay in place during a hold.

Entry: When flat, go long if the close is above the entry SMA. Initialize the stop using the entry close.
Exit: Go to cash if the close is below the updated stop.
Indicators: Entry SMA from 20 closes. The range proxy is the 14-day simple average of absolute close-to-close price changes.
Stop: the maximum of the previous stop and highest close since entry minus 2.5 times the range proxy.

strategies.summary: Trails the highest close since entry with a volatility-sensitive stop that can only rise.

strategies.description: This is an observed-row calendar proxy, not a FOMC or CPI event detector. The blackout sets the whole target to cash, including existing holdings.

zh.bestOn: 带月度空仓窗口的趋势对照
zh.description: 这是按观测行计数的日历代理，不检测FOMC或CPI事件；窗口内将整个目标设为现金，包括退出已有持仓。
notes: 观测行不一定是工作日；不完整首月从首个可用观测开始计数；没有读取实际宏观事件数据。

Entry: 短均线>长均线，且当月行序号≥3时做多。
Exit: 趋势条件不成立或当月行序号<3时空仓。
Indicators: 收盘价SMA50和SMA200；输入中每月观测行从0开始计数。

zh.summary: 每月最初若干观测行空仓的趋势择时。

strategies.name: Trend + Macro Filter
notes: Rows are not necessarily business days. A partial first month counts from its first available row. No real macro-event data is consumed.

Entry: Long when fast average>slow average AND monthly row rank≥3.
Exit: Cash when trend condition fails or monthly row rank<3.
Indicators: SMA50 and SMA200 of close; zero-based observed-row rank within each input month.

strategies.summary: Trend timing with a blackout on the first observed rows of each month.

strategies.description: The trend filter gates entry and exits holdings when the close reaches or falls below the long average. A recovery threshold and time limit also close positions.

zh.description: 趋势过滤用于入场；收盘价触及或跌破长期均线时退出。RSI回升阈值与持仓时限也会触发退出。
notes: 没有使用独立Short_MA参数，也不保证得到更优入场价格。

Entry: 200行后，收盘价>SMA200且RSI<35时入场。
Exit: RSI>50、收盘价≤SMA200或持仓间隔≥20个观测时退出。
Indicators: 收盘价SMA200；RSI14使用涨跌额简单均值，分母加1e-10。

zh.summary: 在长期均线上方按RSI回调做多。

strategies.name: Trend + Mean Reversion Hybrid
notes: No separate Short_MA parameter is used; improved entry prices are not guaranteed.

Entry: After 200 rows, close>SMA200 AND RSI<35.
Exit: RSI>50, close≤SMA200, or holding age≥20 observations.
Indicators: SMA200 of closes; RSI14 from simple mean gains/losses with denominator offset1e-10.

strategies.summary: Buy an RSI pullback above the long moving average.

strategies.description: Uses short, medium, and long SMAs to confirm trend alignment. Long when the fast SMA is above the medium SMA and the medium SMA is above the slow SMA. Exit when the stack reverses.
strategies.name: Triple Moving Average
notes: Reduces whipsaws versus dual MA
Late entry in sharp reversals

Entry: Go long when SMA(Short) > SMA(Medium) > SMA(Long)
Exit: Exit when SMA(Short) < SMA(Medium) < SMA(Long)
Indicators: SMA(Short)
SMA(Medium)
SMA(Long)
