Risk controls: Hold prior position when signals are mixed

strategies.summary: Confirm trend direction with three moving averages.

strategies.description: TRIX is the percentage rate of change of a triple-smoothed closing-price EMA. Signal-line recovery can close a position before TRIX reaches zero.

zh.description: TRIX为收盘价三重EMA的百分比变化率；信号线回升退出可能发生在TRIX仍低于零时。
notes: EMA从已有观测开始初始化；没有完整45行预热或最长持仓期。

Entry: 空仓时，TRIX<−.5%则入场。
Exit: 持仓时，TRIX>0或TRIX>信号线则退出。
Indicators: 三重递归EMA15；TRIX=100×(第三重EMA/上一观测第三重EMA−1)；信号线=EMA9(TRIX)。

zh.summary: TRIX深度为负时买入，超过零线或信号线时退出。

strategies.name: TRIX Reversion
notes: EMAs initialize from available observations; there is no full45-row warmup or maximum holding period.

Entry: When flat, enter when TRIX<−.5%.
Exit: When held, exit when TRIX>0 or TRIX>signal line.
Indicators: Three recursive EMA15 filters; TRIX=100×(EMA3/previousEMA3−1); signal=EMA9(TRIX).

strategies.summary: Buy deeply negative TRIX; exit above zero or its signal line.

strategies.description: Long in the first/last configured weekday-count windows of each calendar month. The Monday-Friday calendar is known without future price rows; it is an approximation, not an exchange holiday calendar.
strategies.name: Turn of Month
notes: Version 2 uses a fixed Monday-Friday calendar and ignores exchange holidays; weekend observations can stay inside a contiguous month-turn window.
The earlier version counted future rows in the downloaded month and could revise earlier targets as new observations arrived.
Institutional rebalancing at month-end
Payroll and pension fund flows
Well-documented calendar anomaly

Entry: Hold when at most Start_Days calendar weekdays have elapsed
Hold when fewer than End_Days calendar weekdays remain
Exit: Exit outside turn-of-month window
Indicators: Elapsed/remaining Monday-Friday calendar weekdays

strategies.summary: Capture month-turn windows using a fixed weekday calendar.

strategies.description: This Turtle-style variant runs one long-or-cash rule with separate entry and exit lookbacks. It uses the prior windows of closes.

zh.description: 这一海龟规则变体用两个收盘价窗口决定满仓多头或现金。
notes: 仓位为满仓多头或现金，信号在收盘时计算。

Entry: 当前收盘价严格高于上界则做多。
Exit: 当前收盘价严格低于下界则转现金，其余保留此前目标。
Indicators: 上界为此前 entry_window 根最高收盘价，下界为此前 exit_window 根最低收盘价。

zh.summary: 突破此前 20 根最高收盘价做多，跌破此前 10 根最低收盘价平仓。

strategies.name: Turtle Trading
notes: Targets are full long or cash. The rule calculates its signals at the close.

Entry: Go long if today's close is strictly above the upper boundary.
Exit: Go to cash if today's close is strictly below the lower boundary. Otherwise keep the prior target.
Indicators: Upper boundary = prior entry_window highest close. Lower boundary = prior exit_window lowest close.

strategies.summary: Uses a 20-bar closing-price breakout entry and a 10-bar closing-price exit.

strategies.description: Ultimate Oscillator blends three horizons of buying pressure to reduce false signals. This implementation uses close-only data to approximate the classic BP/TR calculation, entering on oversold readings and exiting near neutral.
strategies.name: Ultimate Oscillator
notes: Uses three lookback windows to reduce whipsaws
Close-only approximation for BP/TR without full OHLC data

Entry: Buy when UO < 30 (oversold)
Exit: Exit when UO > 50 (neutral)
Indicators: BP = Close - min(Close, Close[-1])
TR = max(Close, Close[-1]) - min(Close, Close[-1])
AvgShort = sum(BP, Short) / sum(TR, Short)
AvgMedium = sum(BP, Medium) / sum(TR, Medium)
AvgLong = sum(BP, Long) / sum(TR, Long)
UO = 100 * (4*AvgShort + 2*AvgMedium + AvgLong) / 7

strategies.summary: Buy oversold Ultimate Oscillator, exit at neutral.

strategies.description: This daily rule calculates a realized-volatility rank, then applies either the price trend or a stateful RSI trade. The middle regime can hold half exposure.

zh.description: 先计算已实现波动率排名，再决定采用价格趋势规则还是有持仓状态的 RSI 规则。中波动区允许半仓。
notes: 回到低波动或中波动区会重置高波动区交易状态。指标暂不可用时，沿用此前仓位。

Entry: 排名低于 40 且满足趋势条件时持 100%。排名在 40 至 70 且满足趋势条件时持 50%。
排名高于 70、且尚无高波动区 RSI 交易时，RSI 低于 30 则满仓做多。
Exit: 低波动和中波动区的趋势条件失败时空仓。高波动区空仓且未达到 RSI 入场条件时仍为空仓，已有 RSI 多头在 RSI 高于 50 时平仓。
Indicators: 波动率为日收益率样本标准差年化。排名等于最近 pct_window 个波动率值中严格低于当前值的比例。
趋势条件为收盘高于 50 日简单均线。RSI 使用收盘价涨跌额的简单均值。

zh.summary: 低与中波动区用趋势，高波动区用 RSI 回归。

strategies.name: Volatility Regime Strategy
notes: A low or middle regime resets the high-volatility trade state. Unavailable indicators carry the prior target.

Entry: Below rank 40, set 100% if the trend test passes. In ranks 40 through 70, set 50% if it passes.
Above rank 70, enter a 100% long when RSI falls below 30 while the high-regime RSI trade is inactive.
Exit: Low and middle ranks target cash if the trend test fails. Above rank 70, remain in cash if the RSI entry condition fails, and exit an active RSI long only when RSI exceeds 50.
Indicators: Volatility is the annualized sample standard deviation of daily returns. Rank is the share of the current pct_window volatilities strictly lower than the current value.
Trend test is close > SMA50. The RSI uses simple averages of closing-price gains and losses.
Inputs: vol_lookback = 20, pct_window = 252, low_vol_pct = 40, high_vol_pct = 70, trend_ma = 50, rsi_period = 14, rsi_oversold = 30, rsi_exit = 50.

strategies.summary: Uses trend signals in low and middle volatility and RSI reversion in high volatility.

strategies.description: This rule combines a realized-volatility percentile with a fixed closing-price SMA. The volatility regime and trend jointly determine the daily exposure.

zh.description: 用已实现波动率排名判断市场状态，同时以固定窗口的收盘均线确认趋势。两者共同决定每日多头仓位。
notes: 趋势条件不满足时，也可能根据信号所在波动区间保留部分多头。

Entry: 排名低于低阈值时，上涨趋势持 100%，其余持 50%。
排名介于两个阈值之间（含边界）时，上涨趋势持 75%，其余持 25%。
Exit: 排名高于高阈值时持有现金。排名缺失时沿用此前目标。
Indicators: 波动率为 vol_lookback 个日收益率的样本标准差乘 √252。排名为波动率滚动窗口中严格低于当前值的比例。
收盘严格高于 50 日均线时判为上涨趋势。
Inputs: 默认 vol_lookback = 20，percentile_window = 252，low_percentile = 50，high_percentile = 80。趋势均线固定为 50 日。

zh.summary: 按已实现波动率排名和 50 日价格趋势共同确定仓位。

strategies.name: Volatility Regime Switch
notes: The rule can retain partial long exposure even when the trend test fails, depending on the volatility rank.

Entry: Below the low percentile, target 100% in an uptrend or 50% otherwise.
Between thresholds, including equality, target 75% in an uptrend or 25% otherwise.
Exit: Above the high percentile, target cash. Carry the prior target if volatility rank is missing.
Indicators: Volatility is the sample standard deviation of vol_lookback daily returns multiplied by √252. Rank is the share of the rolling volatility window strictly below the current value.
Trend is up when the close strictly exceeds the 50-day SMA.
Inputs: vol_lookback = 20, percentile_window = 252, low_percentile = 50, high_percentile = 80. The trend SMA is fixed at 50 days.

strategies.summary: Sizes positions from both realized-volatility rank and the 50-day price trend.

strategies.bestOn: Single markets with changing short- and medium-term realized volatility
strategies.description: Volatility Risk Premium is the historical name. The strategy uses two realized-volatility windows from the tested instrument's daily returns to set long or cash targets.

zh.bestOn: 长短期已实现波动率关系变化的单标的市场
zh.description: 波动率风险溢价是此策略的历史名称。实际规则用所测标的的日收益率计算两条已实现波动率，在多头和现金间切换。
notes: 25% 上限用于设置多头。长窗口波动率超过 25% 后，如果差值未触发退出，原有多头仍可保留。

Entry: 经过 realized_lookback + 5 根预热后，差值高于 2 个百分点且长窗口波动率低于 25% 时设为多头。
Exit: 差值低于 −2 个百分点时转现金，其余维持此前目标。
Indicators: 两个窗口均取日收益率样本标准差乘 √252。波动率差等于长窗口波动率减短窗口波动率。
Inputs: 默认 realized_lookback = 20，implied_lookback = 5（短期已实现波动率窗口），vrp_threshold = 0.02。

zh.summary: 用长短窗口已实现波动率之差决定多头仓位。

strategies.name: Volatility Risk Premium
notes: The 25% ceiling applies to setting a long target. An existing long can carry through higher volatility when the spread does not trigger an exit.

Entry: After realized_lookback + 5 bars, set long when the spread exceeds 2 percentage points and longer-window volatility is below 25%.
Exit: Set cash when the spread is below −2 percentage points. Otherwise keep the last target.
Indicators: For both windows use the sample standard deviation of daily returns × √252. The spread equals longer-window volatility minus shorter-window volatility.

strategies.summary: Times long exposure using the difference between longer- and shorter-window realized volatility.

strategies.bestOn: Single-asset volatility targeting with a leverage cap
strategies.description: Daily exposure increases when trailing realized volatility falls and decreases when it rises. The rule caps the target weight and realized volatility can differ from the target.

zh.bestOn: 带杠杆上限的单资产目标波动率策略
zh.description: 近期已实现波动率下降时提高目标仓位，波动率上升时降低。规则设有仓位上限，实际波动率可能偏离目标。
notes: 站点对各品种单独回测，并在下一个可用收益区间应用日度目标。
回测允许最高 150% 的模拟多头敞口。Pine 示例采用碎股数量与 TradingView 收盘下单设定。

Entry: 当波动率估计为正时，用目标波动率除以已实现波动率，再将权重限制在零和上限之间。
Exit: 波动率缺失或为零时，将目标设为现金。
Indicators: 用收盘到收盘日收益率的样本标准差乘以 √252 年化。缺失收益率以零处理，包括第一条。
Inputs: 默认目标年化波动率 10%，窗口为 20 个日收益率，仓位上限为 1.5 倍。
Position sizing: 默认可使用超过 100% 的敞口，最高为 150%。

zh.summary: 动态调整多头敞口，力求达到 10% 年化波动率目标。

strategies.name: Volatility Target
notes: The site evaluates each instrument separately and applies the daily target to the next available return interval.
The backtest allows up to 150% synthetic long exposure. The Pine example uses fractional orders and TradingView close-order settings.

Entry: On a positive volatility estimate, divide target volatility by realized volatility and clip to the range from zero to the cap.
Exit: Set the target to cash if the volatility estimate is unavailable or zero.
Indicators: Calculate sample standard deviation of daily close-to-close returns and annualize with √252. Missing returns, including the first, are treated as zero.
Inputs: Default target volatility 10%, lookback 20 daily returns and cap 1.5×.
Position sizing: The default permits exposures above 100% up to the 150% cap.

strategies.summary: Scales long exposure toward a 10% annualized volatility target.

strategies.description: The breakout compares today's closing-price return with the sample standard deviation of the last 20 daily returns. A return above 1.5 times that standard deviation signals full long exposure.

zh.description: 把当天收盘到收盘的收益率与最近 20 个日收益率的样本标准差比较。当天收益率超过标准差的 1.5 倍时，目标为满仓做多。
notes: 计算波动率时包含当天收益率。当天收益率为零时沿用先前仓位。

Entry: 当天收益率严格高于滚动标准差的 1.5 倍时做多。
Exit: 当天收益率为负时转为现金。未触发进出场条件时保持原仓位。
Indicators: 收盘到收盘的日收益率与 20 日滚动样本标准差。
Inputs: 固定值：波动率窗口为 20 个日收益率，入场倍数为 1.5。

zh.summary: 日收益率异常高时做多，出现负收益日时平仓。

strategies.name: Volatility Breakout
notes: The volatility estimate includes today's return. A zero return leaves the previous target in place.

Entry: Go long when today's return exceeds 1.5 times its rolling standard deviation.
Exit: Go to cash when today's return is negative. Otherwise keep the previous target if the entry condition does not trigger.
Indicators: Daily close-to-close return and its 20-day rolling sample standard deviation.
Inputs: Fixed: volatility lookback = 20 daily returns, entry multiplier = 1.5.

strategies.summary: Enters after an unusually positive daily return and exits on the first negative return.

strategies.description: The two Vortex components use cross-bar distances between highs and lows, normalized by true range.

zh.description: 涡旋指标统计相邻 K 线高低价之间的距离，并用真实波幅归一化。
notes: 复现生产规则应使用 OHLC 数据。仅输入收盘价时，两分量的分子完全相同。

Entry: VI+ 高于 VI− 时设为多头。
Exit: VI+ 低于 VI− 时设为现金。两者相等或无法比较时沿用此前仓位。
Indicators: VI+ 为 |最高价 − 上一根最低价| 的滚动合计除以真实波幅合计。VI− 用 |最低价 − 上一根最高价| 与相同分母。

zh.summary: 基于 OHLC 计算的正向涡旋分量领先时做多。

strategies.name: Vortex Indicator
notes: Use OHLC bars to reproduce the production rule. With close-only input both components have identical numerators.

Entry: Set the target to long when VI+ > VI−.
Exit: Set the target to cash when VI+ < VI−. Carry the prior target if they tie or the comparison is unavailable.
Indicators: VI+ = rolling sum of |high − prior low| divided by rolling true range sum. VI− uses |low − prior high| and the same denominator.

strategies.summary: Sets long exposure when the OHLC-based positive Vortex component leads.

strategies.description: The52-week label uses252 observations of closing prices, not calendar weeks or intraday highs. Entry and exit thresholds create a holding band.

zh.description: “52周”名称实际使用252个收盘价观测，不是日历周或盘中最高价；不同入退阈值形成持仓缓冲区。
notes: 研究启发不等于复现所引论文的横截面股票组合；没有时间止损。

Entry: 252行后，空仓且比值≥.95时入场。
Exit: 持仓且比值<.85时退出，否则继续持有。
Indicators: 比值=当前收盘价/包含当前行的252行窗口最高收盘价。

zh.summary: 接近滚动收盘价高点时做多，较深回撤后退出。

strategies.name: 52-Week High Momentum
notes: Research inspiration is not a replication of the cited cross-sectional stock portfolio. There is no time stop.

Entry: After 252 rows, when flat enter if ratio≥.95.
Exit: When held, exit if ratio<.85; otherwise keep holding.
Indicators: Ratio=current close/maximum close over the current252-row window.

strategies.summary: Buy near a rolling closing-price high and hold until a deeper pullback.

strategies.description: Uses rolling closing-price extrema instead of OHLC highs and lows. The exit threshold is the overbought zone, not neutral.

zh.description: 用滚动收盘价极值替代OHLC最高/最低价；退出阈值位于超买区域，并非中性区。
notes: 收盘价区间为零时R=0，不触发超卖入场。

Entry: 14个观测后，R<−80时入场。
Exit: R>−20或持仓间隔≥20个观测时退出。
Indicators: R=−100×(最高收盘价−收盘价)/(最高收盘价−最低收盘价+1e-10)。

zh.summary: 收盘价威廉指标低于−80时做多，高于−20或持仓20个观测后退出。

strategies.name: Williams %R Reversion
notes: Flat close ranges give R=0 and do not trigger oversold entries.

Entry: After 14 observations, enter when R<−80.
Exit: Exit when R>−20 or holding age≥20 observations.
Indicators: R=−100×(highestClose−close)/(highestClose−lowestClose+1e-10).

strategies.summary: Buy close-based Williams R below−80; exit above−20 or at 20 bars.

strategies.description: Both filters gate new entries only. Existing holdings persist until the one-sided z-score recovery exit.

zh.description: 两项过滤只限制新入场；已有持仓等到单侧z分数回升条件成立才退出。
notes: 即使禁用过滤，仍保留200行预热；没有时间止损，过滤也不保证改善收益。

Entry: 200个观测后：z<−2，启用时波动率须严格位于(.10,.50)，启用时趋势距离须<.10。
Exit: z>−.5时退出，否则持有。
Indicators: 价格z使用样本标准差；收益波动率乘sqrt252年化；趋势距离为abs(收盘价/SMA200−1)。

zh.summary: 波动率与趋势入场过滤合格时，按较低价格z分数做多。

strategies.name: Z-Score Mean Reversion
notes: The200-row warmup remains even with filters disabled. There is no time stop, and the filters do not guarantee improved returns.

Entry: After 200 observations: z<−2, enabled volatility filter strictly.10<vol<.50, and enabled trend filter distance<.10.
Exit: Exit when z>−.5; otherwise hold.
Indicators: Price z uses sample standard deviation. Annualized return volatility uses sqrt252; trend distance is abs(close/SMA200−1).
Inputs: lookback=20, entry_z=2, exit_z=.5; vol_filter=true, trend_filter=true, min_vol=.10, max_vol=.50, trend_threshold=.10.

strategies.summary: Buy low price z-scores when entry volatility and trend filters allow.
